rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las// gang du (50)bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do// rim lnga las// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rang gi rang rig ye shes na// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// zhes pas// bde ba chen po ni// rang gi sems nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs te/ de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i phyag 'tshal ba'o// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la bzhi/ lta ba/ bsgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la gsum las/ dang po snang ba phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// phyag rgya chen po brjod bya ba// chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin te dngos pos stong*// ji skad du/ rdo rje gur las// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// rnam par shes pa'i gnas don du// phyi rol gyur pa gang yang med/ he badz+ra las// rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can te// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa nyid/ ces dang*// 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang*// sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur// sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// sangs rgyas gzhan tu bstan du med/ ces dang*/ dus 'khor las// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas chen po gzhan 'dir 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin// de rnams mnyes par byas nas dpag med srid pa gcod par byed de rnam par mi rtog pa las so// gsang 'dus las// chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste// ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing*// rang bzhin dag pa de nyid la// 'khrul pa'i rdo rje rab tu gsungs/ zhes te/ de'i don ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i don brjod par bya ba ni/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni rang gi sems kyis btags pa tsam du (51)zad pas/

phyi rol gyi don dang*/ de mthong ba'i 'khrul pa'i blo ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs nyams su myong ba'i shes pa bzhin/ don dam par yul yul can gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste dngos pos stong pa'o// gnyis pa rig pa phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa ni// sems kyang dran rig 'gyu ba tsam// rang bzhin med de rlung gi rtsal// ngo bos stong pa nam mkha' 'dra// chos kun mkha' 'dra mnyam gnas pa'o// ji skad du/ rdor phreng las// ji ltar mes bsreg dngos po med// rgyu med par ni thim nas 'gro// slar yang srog gi rlung shar nas// las kyi rlung ni sna tshogs pa// de ni lhan cig rnam shes dang*// slar yang 'jig rten gsum du gnas// de las las dang de bzhin skyes// de las chags sogs bag chags dang*// de las slar yang 'chi dang skye// de ltar 'khor lo bskor ba 'dra// zhes dang*/ dgongs pa lung ston las// 'gro ba yul sogs las byed pa// 'dir ni de la brten pa yin/ zhes dang rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis su// shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas// dbang po'i sgo nas byung nas ni// yul rnams la ni 'jug par 'gyur/ dpal mchog dang po las// thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid te// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// mkha' dang mnyam par sbyor ba yis// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ gsang 'dus las// chos rnams ngo bo med pa las// chos kyi de nyid kun bshad pa// e ma ho ngo mtshar las byung ba// nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ don ni/ nang gi sems dran rig 'gyu ba gsal tsam 'di ni/ rang bzhin med de/ las rlung gi gzhan dbang can gyi rtsal las byung ba'i phyir/ ngo bos stong pa nam mkha' dang 'dra bas na/ gzung 'dzin gyi (52)chos kun gdod nas ma byung zhing ma skyes pa mkha' dang 'dra zhing mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'o// gsum pa zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// phyag rgya che zhes brjod pa ni// rang gi ngo bos bstan du med// de phyir sems kyi de bzhin nyid// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nyid do// ji skad du/

phyag chen thig le las// bdag gi ngo bo brjod mi nus// sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang rnyed dka'// brtag gnyis las// ngo bos gzugs med mthong ba po yang med// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// rig med rig pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba med/ don ni/ de bas phyag rgya che zhes tshig tu brjod pa ni/ don dam par rang gi ngo bos 'di zhes bstan du med do// phyi don dang*/ rang rig gnyis ka la gzung 'dzin gyi bden grub ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ blo las 'das shing yid la byar med pa/ gdod ma nas zung 'jug mnyug ma sems kyi de bzhin nyid ni/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las nam yang ma g.yos pa nyid do// de ltar snang ba bden med/ rig pa skye med/ zung 'jug blo 'das gsum gyis lta ba phyag rgya chen po khas len dang bral bar gtan la phabs nas/ gnyis pa bsgom pa phyag rgya chen po bstan pa la gsum las dang po gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don tu gsungs pa// de la bcos shing bsgyur du med// gang gis de nyid mthong rtogs na// snang srid thams cad phyag rgya che// chos sku khyab gdal chen po pas/ ji skad du// gsang 'dus las// dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// sdom 'byung las/ de (53)bzhin sems de sems med la// gcig dang sna tshogs rtog par byed// dngos po dngos med bya brag dag /rnam spangs gang na gang nyid ni// lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin gsal/ phyag chen thig le las// gzhan yang chos kyi dbyings su grags// de nyid nyon cig bdag gis bshad// nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings yin te// dbyings ni sa bon zhes su bstan// chos rnams kun gyi nang na yod// rgyu dang mchog gi gnas yin no// ji ltar til nang mar yod bzhin// ji ltar shing rnams me yod pas// de bzhin chos rnams kun la yod/

gsang 'dus las// dngos po 'di rnams ma skyes pas// chos dang chos nyid med pa ste// nam mkha' lta bur bdag nyid las// byang chub tshul 'di brten pa'o// phyag chen thig le las// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// gal te kun rdzob gzugs su rnyes// 'jig rten khams ni grangs med la// gzhan ni ma yin bdag gis khyab/ don ni/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po de la lam gyis bcos shing bsgyur bas blang ba dang dor bar bya ba med do/ gang gis gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa thams cad las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid mthong ba med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs shing khong du chud par gyur na// snang srid thams cad phyag rgya chen po chos sku khyab bdal chen po las don gzhan logs su grub pa med pa'i phyir// de bas na lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su btags pa thams cad kyang gzhi rang byung gi ye shes las ma g.yos par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rtogs tshul phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// rang bzhin ma bcos lhug par bzhag /bsam du med pa chos kyi sku// ma btsal bzhag na bsgom pa ste// btsal zhing bsgom pa 'khrul pa'i blo// (54)ji skad du/ dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud las// de nas skyil krung bcas nas ni// sna yi rtse mor bltas nas kyang*// rang gi rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyis// de nyid mthong bar mnyam par bzhag rdo rje snying po rgyun gyi rgyud las// de ltar bzhugs par gyur nas kyang*// ji srid sems ni mi skyo'i bar// mnyam bzhag yid ni bzang po'i ngang*// de la 'bad de bsgom par bya/ sdom 'byung las/ gang tshe de nyid la reg pas// bsam pa thams cad bsam du med// gang tshe bsam du med sems pa// de tsho bsam mi khyab par 'gyur/ don ni/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin las ma bcos par lhugs par bzhag pas/ bsam du med pa'i don so so rang rig pas nyams su myong ba ni lam dus kyi chos sku yin la/

des na rang gi sems las gzhan du ma btsal bar sems rang lugs su bzhag nas bsgom par bya ste/ gzhan du btsal zhing bcos nas bsgom pa na gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i blo las ma 'das pa nyid do// gsum pa dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa/ mkha' dang cho 'phrul ji lta ba// sgom dang mi bsgoms gnyis med pa// bral dang ma bral ga la yod// rnal 'byor pas ni de ltar rtogs/ ji skad du/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ bde mchog las/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong pa'i ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom/ rdo rje gur las/ sngags med bzlas pa'ang yod ma yin// 'gro ba gsum po thams cad med// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis// sgom pa dang ni bsgom bya med/ don ni// (55)nam mkha' dag pa las cho 'phrul sprin dang 'ja' tshon sogs snang ba'i dus nas snang ba med pa ji ltar bar/ sgom pa'i dus na gzung 'dzin du bsgom pa med la/ rang gi ngo bo las ma g.yos pas mi sgom pa'ang med pa ste// de ltar bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags rang bzhin med pas bral ba med la sems kyi chos nyid dang lhan cig tu mi gnas pas ma bral ba'ang ga la yod/ de bas na don dam pa'i bden pa phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la yid mnyam par sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis de ltar rtogs par bya'o// de rnams kyis gnas lugs ma bcos pa// rtogs tshul bsam du med pa// dbyer med mtha' dang bral ba gsum gyis sgom pa phyag rgya chen po yid phyed dang bral bar gtan la phabs nas/ gsum pa spyod pa phyag rgya chen po la gsum las/ dang po rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// dge dang sdig pa'i las rnams kun// de nyid shes pas grol bar 'gyur// nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste// nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor grogs/

ji skad du/ sam+bu ṭi las// kun rtog mang po'i mun pas khyab gyur pa'i// rab tu 'joms pas smyo zhing glog 'gyu ba// chags sogs dgag dka'i dri mas gos gyur pa'i// sems ni rdo rje can gyis 'khor bar gsungs// rang bzhin 'od gsal rtog las rnam par grol/ ces dang*// de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi// cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste// 'di ltar chos ni rang bzhin dag /ma skyes pa dang gnas pa med/ rdo rje gur las// gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ji lta bar// de ltar dngos po bsgom par bya// stong nyid dri med mchog gi gnas// der ni bsod nams sdig pa med/ bde mchog 'byung ba las// dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la// blang dang dor ba ga la zhig /blang dang dor (56)bar bya ba yi// chos kun rmi lam ji bzhin no// brtag gnyis las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur zhing*// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur/ don ni// 'khor ba ni las las byung zhing*/ las ni blang bya dge ba dang dor bya sdig pa'i las te/ de rnams kun kyang rnam par rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam las rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i de kho na nyid shes na grol bar 'gyur ro// las de'ang nyon mongs pa las byung zhing*/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes na ye shes phyag rgya chen por 'char bar 'gyur te/ nags tshal mes tshig pa la rlung grogs su 'gyur ba bzhin// rang bzhin shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams nyon mongs pa ye shes kyi grogs su 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ro snyoms phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// 'gro dang 'dug tu ga la yod// dgon par phyin nas bsam gtan ci// de nyid ma rtogs gang gis kyang*// gnas skabs tsam las grol mi 'gyur/ ji skad du/ gsang 'dus las// chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// brtags gnyis las/

gzugs la sogs pa yul rnams dang*// gzhan yang rnal 'byor pas mthong ba// dngos po de kun dag pa ste// 'di ltar 'gro ba sangs rgyas bdag /rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid// dag pa gzhan gyi rnam grol min/ don ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'gro ba ste rjes thob dang*/ 'dug pa ste mnyam bzhag gnyis tha dad du 'dzin pa ga la yod de/ thams cad (57)chos nyid kyi rol pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ des na dgon pa ste gnas dben par phyin nas bsam gtan bsgoms pas ci zhig bya ste/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob ro mnyam par phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes las ma g.yos pa'i de kho na nyid ma rtogs na/ gzhan gang gis kyang gnas skabs nyon mongs pa mgo mnan pa tsam las srid pa'i sa bon drung nas 'byin mi nus pas/ mthar thug gi grol ba thob pa mi 'gyur ro// gsum pa dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// de nyid rtogs na gang gis 'ching*// ngang la ma yengs gnas pa las// mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag ces// gnyen pos bcos shing bsgom du med/ ji skad du/ brtag gnyis las// chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'babs dang*// mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar// rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis// nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /sa m+bu ṭi las// dbang po gang dang gang lam nyid// de dang de yi rang bzhin las// mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor gyi// rtag par shin tu mnyam bzhag nyid/ gur las// sems pa med cing bsgom pa med// sngags med lha yang med pa ste// kye yi rdo rje las byung ba// 'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o// don ni/ ji skad bshad pa ltar de kho na nyid rtogs na gzung 'dzin las grol bas yul yul can gang gis kyang 'chi bar mi 'gyur bas// de kho na nyid kyi ngang las ma yengs par gnas pa las/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang ma bzhag pa zhes gnyen pos bcos shing bsgom du med de/

mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa'i ye shes chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pa ni spyod pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsungs so// de ltar ngo bo rang grol/ mtshan nyid ro mnyam/ mthar thug dbyer med pa gsum gyis spyod pa phyag rgya chen po rang shar rang grol du gtan la phab (58)nas// bzhi pa 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po la gsum/ dang po snang srid rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtog pa rang grol ye shes che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos sku'o// ji skad du/ phag mo mngon 'byung las// snang ba med pa'i gnas la gnas// snang ba med pa yang dag brten// spyod pa med pa'i chos rnams la// chos can med cing chos nyid med// rten 'brel mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos// dngos med mtshan ma med pa'o// gur las// ma skyes pa dang mi dmigs pa// mi phyed nam mkha' lta bu ste// zab cing zhi ba'i rang bzhin ni// 'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o// de lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs 'di la ni don dam par spros pa'i mtshan ma gang yang ma grub pa ste/ phyi rol gyi don ma skyes pas snang ba rang grol chos dbyings su shar/ nang shes pa mi dmigs pas rtog pa rang grol ye shes chen por dag /gsang ba gzung 'dzin gnyis med blo 'das mnyam pa chen por brdal bas zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i chos kyi sku mngon du gyur ba'o// gnyis pa 'khor 'das dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// ji ltar spyad kyang don dang ldan// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas nyid// 'khor ba yul med bde ba che'o// ji skad du/ brtag gnyis las// 'di ni 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid// 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ kha sbyor las// bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin spangs shing*// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes de// dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog

/mkha' mnyam sbyor ba rdul dang bral// 'dod chags chags bral 'dres pa ste// thabs (59)dang shes rab shin tu 'dres// de nyid srogs chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa ste// de nyid kyis ni thams cad khyab// de 'di sangs rgyas ye shes te// dpal ldan he ru ka zhes bya// 'di dang de dang gzhan yang rung*// dngos dang dngos med 'di las byung*/ zhes dang*// sdug bsngal phung po du ma'i mtshan gyur pa// 'di las gzhan du cung zad yod ma yin// bde ba mtha' yas 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur pa// de las gzhan du 'gro ba yod ma yin// sdug bsngal ma lus zad par 'dod pa dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde mchog thob 'dod pas// sems ni brtan par byas nas 'bad pas spyad// de yi rang bzhin dngos po med par bya// ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa'i yol stug pos// skye dgu'i yid bsgribs de srid sdug mtha' yas// ji srid de nas de ni bral yin pas// de srid bde ba rgya chen tha dad min// mnyam pa kun gyi mthar thug 'phags dgyes pa'i// de yi zad phyir rang gi bya ba yang*// rgyas pa de yis rang gi 'gro ba blta/ don ni/ de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni chu bo chen po rgyun chad pa med par 'bab pa ltar/ dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa las ma 'das pas ji ltar spyad kyang don dang ldan pa nyid de// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas kun dang dgongs pa dbyer mi phyed pa nyid kyi phyir// 'khor ba yul med mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba chen po 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'bras bu mngon tu gyur pa'o// gsum pa mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i don du gsungs pa// chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /blo bral yid la mi byed pas// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// ji skad du/ kha sbyor las/ stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste// stong (60)min bsgom par mi bya'o// stong pa mi spangs rnal 'byor pas// stong min yongs su mi spang ngo*// stong dang stong min gzung ba las// rnam rtog nyung min skye bar 'gyur/

sdom 'byung las/ /yid med yid ni byas nas su// cung zad tsam yang bsam mi bya// stan la gnas bcas bla ma yi// drin gyis yang dag sbyar bar bya// mkha' dang nam mkha' mnyam de bzhin// sems ni ro mnyam bsgom bya ste// bsam gtan 'dzin pas nges par grol// rtog ge'i sbyor ba rnam par spangs// ces dang*/ de bzhin sems des sems med la// gcig dang tha dad ji ltar rtog /dngos dang dngos med shes rab dag /rnam spangs gang na rang nyid ni// lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin gsal/ don ni/ 'di ltar snang ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi chos rnams ni/ rang rang gi ngo bos stong zhing*/ stong par 'dzin mkhan gyi shes bya'i blo'i sgrib pa'ang rang sar dag pas blo bral yid la mi byed pa 'di ni dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs la 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i lam rmad du byung ba ste/ rtogs bya'i gzhi dang*// thob bya'i 'bras bu'ang de las logs su ma dmigs pas na gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med pas ni mthar thug don gyi phyag rgya chen por shes par bya'o// de ltar na snang srid rang grol/ 'khor 'das dbyer med/ mthar thug blo 'das gsum gyis 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po rang bzhin lhun grub du gtan la phabs nas/ gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum// skal ldan la gdams pa/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba// mdzad byang gis mtha' brgyan pa'o// dang po ni// skal pa rab tu gyur pa la// bdag gi snying gtam tshig tu bsdus/ ji skad du/ dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud las// khyad par du yang mdor bsdus pa// bdag gis gsal (61)bar bshad pa ni// rmongs pa rnams la phan 'dod pas// snying rjes 'dir ni bstan pa yin/ don ni/ rdo rje theg pa snying po don gyi gsang lam du dkrir rung pas dad pa dang skal pa rab tu gyur pa la/ nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta bdag gis snying phyung nas lag mthil du bzhag pa lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po yid la mi byed pa'i gtam/

nyung ngu'i tshig tu bsdus te bstan pa yin la/ de ltar bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan kyang*/ dang po'i las can zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gzhung bslab par mi nus pa'i blo dman pa rnams la snying brtse bas 'o ma las mar phyungs pa bzhin gdams ngag gnad du bsdus te ngo sprod kyi tshul du brjod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni// 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa// phyag rgya che la gnas par shog /ji skad du/ brtag gnyis las// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas// byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod/ bshad rgyud las// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gis lam gyis 'gro 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas myur thob shog /don ni/ ngo bo stong nyid phyag rgya chen po las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdangs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos gzhung 'di brtsams pas 'gro ba ma lus pa gnas skabs bde ba dang*/ mthar thug phan pa bla na med pa stong nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i lam gyi gzhon pas bgrod de sku bzhi'i 'bras bu la gnas nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog cig ces pa'o// gsum pa ni/ mkhas pa chen po na ro pa'i zhal snga nas/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros la phul+la ha rir gnang ba'o// zhes pa ste go sla'o// zhes pa'ang dpal mkha' spyod dbang po'i sa bcad dang*/ rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i lung sbyor sogs phyogs gcig tu sbyar te/ ngag don mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis (62)bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣas bsdebs pa su shre yo bha ba tu/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ tat+tā da sha ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid bcu pa zhes bya ba// 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig yod med sbyor ba spangs// de bzhin nyid la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ ༈ /gang la rnyogs pa med rang bzhin// byang chub rtogs pa'i rang bzhin can// de bzhin nyid ni shes 'dod pas// rnam bcas ma yin rnam med min// bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i// dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam nyid do// dngos po 'di ni byang chub 'gyur// chags pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin nyid// chags pa las ni 'khrul bar 'gyur// 'khrul pa gnas ni med par 'dod// de nyid ci na dngos rang bzhin// dngos po dngos med gang yin pa'o// dngos po med pa'ang dngos por 'gyur// rgyud dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin gyis// de ltar chos rnams ro gcig ste// thog pa med cing gnas med par// ji ltar 'byung ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// 'di dag thams cad 'od gsal te/

༈ /ji ltar 'byung ba'i ting 'dzin yang*// rab tu 'jig pa'i sems kyis 'gyur// gang phyir de yi gnas rig pas// de nyid rgyun mi 'chad las skye// shes dang shes bya rnam bral ba// 'gro ba nyid ni gnyis med 'dod// gnyis dang bral bar rloms pa yang*// gang phyir de ni 'od gsal 'dod/ ༈ /de lta'i de nyid nges rtogs na// ji lta de ltar gang de na// rnal 'byor mig ni rgyas 'gyur bas// kun tu seng ge de bzhin rgyu// 'jig rten chos las rnam log 'dis// smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la brten nas// dmigs pa med pas thams cad byed// rang byin rlabs pas rnam brgyan pa'o/ ༈ /rnyogs med de nyid gang bstan cing*// gnyis su med pas gang smras pa// mnyam dang mi mnyam spangs pa'o// blo gter rnams kyis shes byar rigs// de kho na nyid (63)brtub/ slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// gzhung 'di/ bla ma phyag na dang*/ mtshur gyis bsgyur zhing*/ phyis lo tsā tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos par snang zhing 'di ni slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa dang mthun par bris pa'o/ rje mar pa lo tsā'i lta bas spros pa gcod pa'i bla ma mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i gsung phyag rgya chen po yid la mi byed pa'i chos nyer bzhi sogs mang du bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas/ lta ba ston pa'i gzhung gtso bor gyur pa ste/ rgya bod kyi 'grel pa'ang ci rigs pa snang ngo*/ ༈ / mnga' bdag mar ba lo tsā bas dpal sa ra ha las gsan pa'i phyag rgya chen po yid la mi byed pa snying po don gyi gdams ngag yi ge bzhi pa'i don rdo rje'i mgur du bzhengs pa ni/ ༈ /dpal de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo*// dus khyad par can gyi tshes bcu la// dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs gral du// bu 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can// khyod klog skya jo sras zhu 'bul ba// sngar ma thos pa'i glu long skad// nga shul ring lam la gshar ba des// lus ngal dub dbang du song ba'i phyir// glu yid 'phrog snyan po ma mchis shing*// tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas po mi shes kyang*// grogs khyed bas ngo che med pa'i phyir// ngo che ba'i dpral ba mi ldog pas// don sngar ma mthong ba'i ya mtshan can// rje bram ze'i bzhed dgongs glur len pas// khyed gdan gang bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rnams// snyan lhan ne gsan la thugs dgongs 'tshal/

༈ /dus kha sang dpyid zla tha chung la// gzhi bal po'i mthil nas 'phags pa yi// gdugs dro lam mtshes kyi shul kha na// bal bo ling gi sho gam ri// gdol ba can gyi grong khyer du// mi brdal mi 'jal gyi shongs ma pas// mgron kha zhan po yi bod rnams bskyil// mi ngas kyang dbang med zhag 'ga' bsdad// dgung nub gcig tham thum rmi lam na// rigs kyi mtshan ldan tshangs skud can// bram ze'i bu mo (64)mdzes ma gnyis// cung zad 'dzum zhing zur mig blta// mi kho bo'i drung du 'ongs nas kyang*// lho dpal gyi ri la 'gro dgos skad// kho bos sngon chad phyin ma myong*// rgyus med lam yang mi shes smras// bu mo gnyis kyi zhal na re// khyed ming pos dka' ba spyad mi dgos// nged kyi phrag la khur gyis zer// 'do li dar gyi lding khrir bcug /gdugs bzhin mkha' la btags nas kyang*// glog 'gyu skad cig yud tsam la// lho dpal gyi ri la phyin pa rmis// shing p+laka sha ljon pa'i bsil grib la// ti ra ro yi gdan steng na// rje bram ze chen po sa ra ha// zhal sngar ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can// btsun mo gnyis kyis mtha' brten nas// sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// dges pa'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs can// bu bde bar 'ongs sam zhes kyang gsungs// rje mthong ba dga' bas ma bzod par// lus kyi spu g.yos mchi ma 'khrugs// lan bdun bskor zhing brkyang phyag 'tshal// zhabs mthil spyi bor blangs nas kyang*// pha thugs rjes zung zhes gsol btab pas// lus la sku yi byin rlabs pa// phyag dbang spyi bor reg tsam gyis// lus zag med bde bas ra ro ba// glang chen chang gis myos pa bzhin// g.yo 'gul med pa'i nyams shig shar// ngag la gsungs gis byin brlabs pa// stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis// yi ge bzhi pa'i don gsungs pa// lhug pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// yid la thugs kyis byin brlabs pa// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pas// dur khrod gnas pa'i mi ro bzhin// bsam du med pa'i nyams shig shar// rdo rjes bde chen dag pa'i gsungs// rin chen mgur gyi bum pa nas// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi brda skad kyis// sprin bral nam mkha' stong pa'i don// gnas lugs mtshon (65)pa rdo rje'i mgur// skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/

༈ /na mo// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// rgyun chad med pa gnyug ma'i sems// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// nam mkhas nam mkha' sbyor ba mthong*// rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa'i phyir// yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung*// sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis// sems la lhan pa gdab tu med// snang srid sems kyi rang bzhin shes// gnyen pos bcos te sgom du med// sems kyi gnas lug dran du med// de yang ma bcos ngang la bzhag /de don mthong na grol ba'i phyir// bu chung gdol pa'i spyod pa ltos// sha za smyon pa gang dgar mthong*// snyems dang bral ba'i seng ge bzhin// sems kyi glang po yan du chug /bung ba me tog rgyu ba ltos// 'khor ba skyon du mi lta zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa thob byar med// tha mal shes pa rang lugs de// ma bcos so ma nyid du bzhag /bya ba rnams la khyod ma rtog /phyogs dang cha la mi gnas shing*// spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos/ ༈ /chos zad sar 'khyol ba snying po'i don// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// sems gnad du bsnun pa'i brda don zhig /bram ze chen po'i zhal nas thos/ ༈ /skad cig de la gnyid kyang sad// de ma brjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zin// ma rig gnyid kyi mun khung du// rig pa ye shes mthong phye nas// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ltar// 'khrul pa'i mun nag sangs nas thal// dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal mjal kyang*// phyin chad dri rgyu med do snyam// sems kho thag chod pa'i nyams shig skyes// yid 'gyu ba zad pa ngo mtshar che/ ༈ /e ma// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*// bla mas gsungs pa zab mo'i don// ngag smra ru mi btub gsung na yang*// dgung do nub mi smra'i thabs ma byung*// dus da res tsam zhig ma gtogs pa// sngon chad ngag du brjod ma myong*// da phyin chad bzlas sam rna bar nyon// nga sngon chad shul ri brgyang (66)gi mi// mdza' bshes gnyen med grogs kyang med// lus ngal dub bkres par gyur pa'i tshe// bu khyod kyis gang byas sems la yod// de ma brjed sems la shin tu gcags// drin 'khor bar thal lo snying gi grogs// rje gong na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams// mi bdag la bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal// don 'khrul par gda' na bzod par gsol// zhes gsungs so//

'di'i don ni// yi ge dang po chos kyi sku// gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// yi ge gsum pa sprul pa'i sku// bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ zhes ma hā mu dra'i phyag rgya chen po ces pa 'di nyid la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos bzhi bzhi bshad nas lam gyi skabs su// dang po sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad// gnyis pa sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan// gsum pa sems kyi go las spong*// bzhi pa sems kyi lam khyer bstan// ces mar pa'i thugs bcud phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa grags pa de yin no/ ༈ / rje btsun mi la'i phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed kyi rtsa ba bzhugs so// bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// slob dpon chen po ti lo pas// mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa la// des lho brag mar pa la'o// gung thang pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /lho brag gi rje btsun la// dad cing ni mos gyur nas// zhabs drung du 'khor yun ring*// thugs rjes ni dgongs nas gnang*// gdams ngag ni dang du blangs// rtsol sgrub kyis drag tu bsgoms// bsgom pas yi byin rlabs kyis// lus la ni gtum mo 'bar// ras gos ni rkyang res dros// sems la ni 'od gsal shar// rgyud lung ni mang gis kyang*// 'di dag dang gzhan mi mnyam// khyad par gyi bye brag ltos// nyams su ni len pa'i dus// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pa'o// de la 'dir sems nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs ni phyag rgya chen po yin te// 'di la phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la gsum ste// gzhi phyag rgya (67)chen po// lam phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'o// dang po dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ sems can gyi sems nyid/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub pa/ mtha' dang dbus su ma grub/

rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ yod ma myong*// med ma myong*/ ma 'khrul/ ma grol/ rgyus ma bskyed/ rkyen gyi ma bsgyur/ sangs rgyas mkhas te ma bcos/ sems can blun te ma bslad/ rtogs pas bzang du ma song*/ 'khrul pas ngan du ma song*/ de ni gzhi kun la gnas pas gzhi phyag rgya chen po'o// lam phyag rgya chen po ni/ gzhi de'i steng du nyams su blangs pa'i chos 'jog dus dmigs med du 'jog /gnas na yengs med du gnas/ khyer dus 'dzin med du khyer/ 'char na chos nyid du 'char/ grol dus rang grol du 'gro ba gcig nyams su len pa'o// de ni lam phyag rgya chen po'o// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni// grol bya grol byed dang bral ba// re dogs dang bral ba/ blo zad chos zad 'dzin med zhes pa blo las 'das pas brjod pa dang bral ba'o// de ni 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'o// 'dir gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du nyams su len pa'o// phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed kyi gdams pa/ rje btsun mi la rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'o// / ༈ /rje sgam po pa'i phyag rgya chen po lam gcig chod bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgam po pa'i phyag rgya chen po lam gcig chod 'di la gsum ste/ gnas lugs kyi kho thag bcad pa dang*/ yin lugs kyi ngo sprad pa dang*/ de kho na nyid la lam sbyangs pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ phyag rgya chen po la rgyu med// phyag rgya chen po la rkyen med// phyag rgya chen po la thabs med// phyag rgya chen po la lam med// phyag rgya chen po la 'bras bu med do// gnyis pa yin lugs ngo sprad pa la lnga ste/ phyag rgya chen (68)po la rgyu med do/ dad pa dang mos gus phyag rgya chen po'i rgyu yin/ phyag rgya chen po la rkyen med do/ bla ma dam pa phyag rgya chen po'i rkyen yin/ phyag rgya chen po la thabs med do/ blo ma bcos pa 'di phyag rgya chen po'i thabs yin/

phyag rgya chen po la lam med de/ yid ma yengs pa 'di phyag rgya chen po'i lam yin/ phyag rgya chen po la 'bras bu med de/ blo chos nyid du grol ba 'di phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu yin no// gsum pa de kho na nyid la lam sbyangs pa la bzhi ste/ sngon 'gro dad pa dang*/ mos pa/ gus pa gsum gyis nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// dngos gzhir sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la ma yengs pa'i rtsis bzung la bzhag /rjes la cir snang thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas la rig pa rtsal sbyangs// nyams myong gi 'char lugs la brten nas blo ma zad bar du sgom sgrub la nan tan bya'o// de la nyams myong gi 'char lugs la gnyis te/ mi mthun pa'i nyams dang*/ mthun pa'i nyams so// dang po ni/ bying rgod dang*// na tsha dang*/ 'jigs bred dang*/ the tshom la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i nyams ci byung yang*/ de thams cad bsgoms pa las byung ba yin pas de thams cad nyams su shes par byas la/ mi spang bar de kho na nyid la lta sgom gyi bab byas nas bsgom pas/ mthun pa'i nyams shugs la 'char ro// mthun pa'i nyams ni/ dang po sems gnas pa'i nyams 'char/ de la brten nas ngo bo stong pa'i nyams 'char// de la brten nas rtogs pa thob pa'i nyams 'char// de la brten nas zhen pa log pa'i nyams 'char ro// de ltar nyams myong gi 'char lugs la brten nas// sgrub pa la chog shes med par nan tan bya ba ni// dang po sems gnas pa tsam gyis mi chog /ngo bo mthong mthong du bsgom dgos// ngo bo mthong ba tsam gyis mi chog /rtog pa thob thob tu bsgom dgos/ (69)rtogs pa thob pa tsam gyis mi chog /zhen pa log log tu bsgom dgos// zhen pa log pa tsam gyis mi chog /rang blo chos nyid du grol nas blo zad chos zad du sangs rgyas rgyas su bsgom dgos/ phyag rgya chen po lam gcig chod thugs kyi nying khu zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du// ā ha pra maṇa saṃ mya k+nā ma ḍā ki nī u pa de sha// bod skad du/

bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zag blo yi khyad par gyis// rim gyis pa dang gcig car ba// rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di// gcig car ba yi dug tu 'gyur// gcig car ba yi sman chen 'di// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// des na sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la// gcig car ba ni bstan par bya// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dang po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te// lus dang sems kyi gnas lugs so// lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa ni// rags dang phra dang shin tu phra// thun mong dbyer med rim shes bya// 'od gsal pa las stong pa che// de las thabs shes sna tshogs 'byung*// mngon par byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems// sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa ni// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can// e waṃ lus kyi lte bar gnas// de nyid lus gnas ye shes che// rnam rtog kun spangs de nyid 'grub// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo las dang ni// ye shes phyag rgya'i rnam rtog bral// mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*// mi bsgoms mi sems rang babs gzhag /ji ltar sa bon de bzhin shing*// shing ji lta ba de bzhin 'bras// 'jig rten kun la 'di mthong bas// 'di nyid rten cing (70)'brel 'byung ngo*// lam ni smin grol gnyis su bshad// bla mas bstan pa'i lam gyis ni// slob ma yongs su smin par bya// rdo rje 'chang gis chos bstan pa// rim pa gnyis la yang dag bsten// bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang*// de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// dang po bzhi ste yang na drug /mngon byang lnga ste bsdus pa'i don// lus dben sngags dang sems gsum gyi// sgyu ma mngon par byang chub pas// zung 'jug rim pa shes par 'gyur// las dang ye shes phyag rgya che// dam tshig ces bya 'od gsal nyid// rgyu dang sgom pa thob bya dang*// de bzhin bzhi pa lhun gyis grub// bsnyen pa nyer sgrub bsgrub pa dang*// sgrub chen ngo bo khyad par du

//so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// rim gnyis brgyad du bstan pa ste// gtum mo las kyi phyag rgya dang*// sgyu ma rmi lam 'od gsal dang*// bar do 'pho ba grong 'jug go /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis// phyis nas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rgyu yin te// 'di la gnad ni rnam pa lnga// lus rlung rtsa dus yul lnga'o// lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung*// sgal tshigs rin chen rtsar la rgyus// mthongs kha rgyun du yangs pa dang*// steng sgo shin tu spa bar bya// lce ni yar rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og brtsir// mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar// rlung sems dril la drag tu gcun// rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang na lus ni tsog pur bsdad// re'u mig bzhin bsnol bar bya// rlung la sbyor ba bzhi ldan te// rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// 'phang bar bya dang rnam pa bzhi// lcags kyu bzhin du dgug par bya// bum pa bzhin du dgang ba dang*// rgya mdud bzhin du bsams nas su// mda' ltar (71)gyen du 'phang bar bya// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyin// re tsa ka yis lhung bar byed// kum+bha ka yis dbang du byed// pū ra ka yis kun nas 'gugs// zhi ba yis ni rengs par byed// gtsug tor las ni thig le nyid// me yis zhu ba nyid kyis ltung*// bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gnas// stong nyid lta stangs ltung bar bya// bum pa can gyi 'khor lor son// dpal ba zhes byar rab tu bsgrags// rdo rje pad+mar ting 'dzin brtan// khams gsum po ni dbang du byed// snying ga phyogs su dag pas 'gugs// ma rungs las can de rnams kun// he ru ka dpal rang bzhin phyir// rtag tu lta ngan gzhom bar bya// zhi pas rengs pa nor bu'i mtha'// rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan rnam par bsgom// mchog tu mi 'gyur rtogs gyur pa// de ni mnyam nyid mi g.yor gsungs// rngub pa yis ni dbang du byed// dgangs pa ris ni rengs pa dang*// zhi ba yis ni zhi bar 'gyur// mnyam par ma rungs dpral ba can// dhū tīr tshud na rgyun mi 'bab// dgang ba yis ni lus bkang nas// dug dang rims kyi tsha ba 'phrog

/bum pa can gyis sgo bcings na// sgo yi bu ga dag par 'gyur// 'thor ba sna tshogs rdul du bya// rab tu zhi bas zhi bar 'gyur// yang na og kos ol mdud mnan// yang na mjing pa ltag pa mnan// g.yas nas rgyu na g.yas rtsa mnan// g.yon nas rgyu na g.yon rtsa mnan// don la nu ma bcud la bor// seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya ni// rnal 'byor pa yis bcings nas su// rtag tu srog dang rtsol ba bya// pho rlung 'dul zhing mo rlung sbyangs// ma ning rlung la rgyun du bzla// brjod dang dmigs par bcas pa dang*// brdar gyur dang ni don dam mo// tshig gi brjod pa thun mong ste// dmigs par bcas pa sangs rgyas dngos// (72)sngags kyi de nyid brda ru bshad// don dam de bzhin nyid yin no// srog ni rgyun mi chad gyur spro// a wa dhū tī'i gnas son bzla// rtsa yig nang ni 'di lta ste// skad cig tsam gyis yi dam lha// rgyu ma lta bu'i lus bsgoms te// dus me sgra gcan de nas nyi// ri bong can mas mtshan pa'i dbus// phug nas gtsug tor du son pa// de ni a ba dhū tī'i rtsa// rkyang ma ro ma dang sbyar ba// gdugs dang shing rta ltar gnas pa'i// 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom// de la dus kyi gnad bshad pa// gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug pa// tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhir// sems ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'dra// yul gyi gnad ni gsum yin te// phyi rol dkar dmar rnam pa can// rig ma mtshan ldan grogs su gces// gtum mo a thung yul gyi gnad// nang gi 'khor lo bzhir gtad de// srog rtsol sbyar ba'i sbyor ba yis// lte ba'i a las me sbar te// 'khor lo bzhi bsreg rtsa kha 'byed// me lce haṃ las reg pa yis// nam mkha'i ba ni rim bzhin bzho// byang chub sems kyis rtsa rnams 'gengs// a la babs shing thigs ma chad// bde stong dbyer med don la gzung*// 'byung ba ro snyoms ma shes na// bsgoms kyang rtogs pa mi 'byung ngo*// bcos thabs bgrang gis mi longs kyang*// stong ba'i go cha rtsis su che// lus ni 'grub par gyur ba na// rtags ni rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sreg cing*// spyan la sogs pa yang sreg ste// bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag

/e waṃ bzhi yi bsam gtan bya// lte ba sprul skur dga' bzhi bskyed// lha yi rnal 'byor dus su ni// skra yi rtse mo'i khyon tsam gyis// 'od zer glog stong 'khyug pa bzhin// ba spu'i khung bu'i phyogs mtshams nas// byung ste phyogs bcur gnas pa yis// lha dang lha min bsdigs par mdzad// (73)lus sems srog gi dbyug pa la// sbyor ba drug gi man ngag gnas// thabs dang bcas na shin tu 'bar// lte bar chu shing snying po gnas// snying gar yang ni bsgrengs te gnas// rtag tu stong ba'i sgo yin te// mkhas pas rgyun du bzlog par bya// sgom dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis// ngag gi lam nas zhugs gyur na// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// stong pa'i snying po mtshon pa las// chu shing snye ma'i bdud rtsi bzhin// lte ba chu bo mtshams 'khor lo// gru gsum dkar zhing dmar ba la// thig le kha dog lnga bsam te// sangs rgyas lnga ru mtshon par bya// srog 'gog pa dang ldan byas pas// skad cig nyid la 'bar 'gyur te// 'jig rten khams rnams mchod pa'i gnas// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur// de las 'bras bu 'char ba la// thun mong dang ni khyad par dang*// mchog dang rnam pa gsum yin no// thun mong rim pa bstan pa ni// rlung ni zin par gyur pa yis// dang po dro ba lta bu 'byung*// gnyis pa bde ba 'char ba dang*// gsum pa mi rtog skye bar 'gyur// de nas rnam rtog shugs kyis 'gag /du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang*// skya rengs shar ba ji bzhin dang*// nam mkha' sprin dag lta bu 'byung*// dul zhing brtan pa sa yi rlung*// 'khor gzhong nang du chu blug bzhin// 'jam nyal byed na chu yi rlung*// tsha zhing 'thibs pa me yi rlung*// rtsen zhing mgyogs pa rlung gi rlung*// gsal zhing yang ba nam mkha'i rlung*// las su rung ba'i rtags lnga'o// srog rtsol gnad du tshud pa yis// g.yas g.yon 'pho dang bye brag phyed// tshor ba bde dang rang 'dod du// bsdam dang phyi nang bsre bar nus// nang gi tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags// 'du ba rnam bzhis gnod mi tshugs// mi snang sa 'og nam mkhar rgyu// rkang mgyogs de bzhin bcud kyis len// mkha' 'gro ma rnams khyad par du// (74)skad cig de la sbyor bskyed de// 'byung bzhi gcig la gcig thim nas// tsaṇ+ḍā li ni shugs kyis 'bar// chu shel nges par 'beb pa gang*// gsang ba'i 'khor lo de nas bgrod// 'di ni phyugs chen du gsungs so// khyad par rim pa bstan pa ni// de yi rkyen gyis dhū tī ru// rlung rnams tshud par gyur pa yis// srog thur gong bur gyur pa'i mes// thig le'i tshogs pa gsang bar 'gog

/thig le'i gzugs kyis 'dzag pa yis// bdud rtsi khu ba'i gzugs can ni// thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes bshad do// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// cha med cha las 'das pa ste// bsam gtan bzhi ba'i mthar 'chang ba// nā da'i rnal 'byor zhes byar dran// 'dis ni nad 'phrog tshe spel ba// khyad par rtags lnga yon tan brgyad// mkha' la spyod dang phra sogs ster// mchog gi rim pa bstan pa ni// nyi ma dang ni zla ba'i rlung*// 'pho med dhū tī'i khyim du thim// yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros dang bral bar rab tu zhi// ma bcos gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin gnas// phyi rol yul gyis rtag ma thub// snang ba had bor 'char bar nges// skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// kun tu 'od ni sa chen po// de nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra// bdud rtsi'i 'od ni gnyis pa ste// shin tu 'od gsal zla ba 'dra// nam mkha'i 'od ni gsum pa ste// nam mkha' ji bzhin rab tu gnas// rdo rje'i 'od ni bzhi ba ste// sa de'i 'od ni yid dga' ba// lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan sbyor bas// rdo rje zhes ni yongs su btags// lnga pa rin chen 'od ces bya// dbang bskur ba la rab tu gnas// pad+ma'i 'od ni drug pa ste// pad+ma bzhin du rab tu skye// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid kyis// dri ma med pa yongs su 'dzin// bdun pa las kyi 'od ces pa// sangs rgyas phrin las (75)byed par 'dod// brgyad pa dpe med ces bya ba// de la dpe ni yod ma yin// dpe ldan zhes pa dgu pa ste// thams cad dpe ni so sor rtogs// bcu pa shes rab 'od ces pa// sangs rgyas pa ni bla na med// bcu gcig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid// sa chen rab tu 'od gsal ba// bcu gnyis so so bdag nyid rig /rnal 'byor ye shes rab tu rdzogs// des kyang bsgom skyod ma byung zhing*// ting 'dzin brtan par ma gyur na// las kyi phyag rgya mtshan ldan las// lam lnga 'bras bu thob par bya// sbyor thabs mi shes rnal 'byor dang*// stan yang gcig la mi bsdad de// gal te brgya la bsdad gyur na// shi nas mnar med dmyal bar skye// 'dod chags la sogs sha ma li// yar la bshal zhing mar la 'dud// de phyir sbyor thabs mkhas pas bsten// bstan pa smod pas 'jigs pa na// rang sems tsam la mos pa bya// pad+ma can dang dung can ma// ri mo can dang ri dwags can// bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*// dmangs rigs gdol pa la sogs dang*// ma dang sring mo bu mo yang*// khyad par can gyis bsten gyur na// yon tan 'byung gi skyon du min// bcu gcig ma dang bcu gnyis ma// bcu drug ma dang nyi shu ma// nyi shu bzhi lon bar du bsten// sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las// bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// me tog rab song sbas pa yis// de 'og rdul gyi sbyor bas ni// rgyal po dang ni blon po dang*// gzhon nu ma yang dbang du 'gyur// mi snang ba yi las bya ste// byi la nag mo'i sha ma ni// kham phor kha sbyar nang du skams// bgegs bskrad pa yi cho ga bya// de ltar grib skam byas pa'i rdzas// phye mar btags te rang nyid kyi// mi bskyod pa dang rab sbyar nas// sran ma tsam gyi ril bu bya// ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris nas// kha yi nang du gzhug par bya// kun tu ru yi skabs su ni// bus pa'i sman yang lag (76)tu bcang*// rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can// de dang dben pa'i gnas nyid du// nyam nga med pa'i spyod pa bya// dbab pa sgrub pa'i bye brag gis// gsang la sbyor ba'i dus tsa na// blta dang 'dzum dang 'khyud dang rgod// de la rtsed mo sna tshogs bya// de ni tshogs kyi lam du 'dod// e waṃ gcig tu sbyar byas pas// rnam pa sna tshogs sbyor ba'i lam// rtse mo yun ring drud pa las// rnam par smin pa mthong ba'i lam// gnyis shor gnyis mnyam dbus dag tu// de la ma yengs sgom pa'i lam// dgag bsgrub med par ngo 'phrod pas// mthar thug lam du 'dod pa yin// bsgoms na sangs rgyas kun kyang rgya// ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin// gzung ba 'khrul 'khor man ngag dang*// zangs tshags can dang ting 'dzin no// zlog pa dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhi la// sbyor pa drug dang bzhi ldan sbyar// 'grems pa rnam rol phyag rgya dang*// gzer chen dag gi man ngag go

/de nas rtsa yi nang nyid du// g.yon pa'i srin lag sa la ni// drag tu btsugs nas lus lcid phab// yang na lag pa gnyis kyang rung*// rlung dang bsre ba'i man ngag ni// steng rlung mnan zhing 'og rlung bsdam// dper na nor bu rin chen dag /ma phug pas ni sbyor bral 'gyur// phug pas dga' ba sbyin pa'o// shel dang mtshungs pa'i sems la ni// sbyor bas yul la 'jug pa ste// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis gos pa yin// skyon dang yon tan sems la med// 'di la spang ba gnyis yod de// yon tan med na spang ba dang*// khyad par 'phags nas spang ba'o// khyad par yon tan can gyis kyang*// shes pa skyon pa bsten kyang rung*// 'ga' dang 'ga' yi spyod yul las// kun gyi spyod yul 'di ma yin// phyi dang nang du rnam bye ba// thams cad sgyu ma las gzhan min// de bas 'di ltar 'gro ba kun// sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de// rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus dang*// (77)dag pa lha yi sgyu lus dang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas// thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong*// me long lta bu'i gzugs brnyan gyis// sgyu ma'i lus 'di shes par bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla bas so// mig yor glog dang smig rgyu dang*// brag cha dri za'i grong khyer dang*// rmi lam sgyu ma chu sbur dang*// mig 'phrul mtshungs par gang gis mthong*// sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// 'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin brtags// me long dri ma med pa las// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa'i// gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang mtshungs pas// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// sku ni rjes su dran par bya// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus ngag ni// de nyid bsgoms pas thob par 'gyur// yan lag drug sgom de la ni// slar yang byin gyis brlab bya yin// rjes mthun cho ga'i rim pa 'dis// phyis nas mtshan ma mtshon par bya// dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste// gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o// gsum pa srin bu me khyer dngos// bzhi pa mar me gsal 'bar ba// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu de de// dngos grub nges 'jug nye ba yin// rnal 'byor las ni gang gang dmigs// de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtag

/gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri// ro dang reg bya nyid dag la// mig la sogs pa 'jug gyur pa// sgyu ma lta bur nye bar brtag /gang gang dbang po'i lam gyur nyid// de de'i rang bzhin nyid las grol// don dam nyid phyir sbyar ba yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo 'gyur// phyis nas sgyu ma'i rnam pa ltar// rmi lam rnam par skad cig 'gyur// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// ji srid rdo rje'i lus dang ldan// khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba// ma lus lus pa med par 'grub// dmigs med kun rdzob dag tu ni// sgyu ma lta bur rab tu (78)bshad// kun nas phyag dang kun nas zhabs// kun nas spyan dang dbu dang zhal// kun nas snyan ldan 'jig rten na// kun tu thams cad g.yogs nas bzhugs// rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid du// mang du bshad pas smos ci dgos// chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste// ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing*// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid la// 'khrul pa log pa rab tu gsungs// don bzhis nyams su blang bar bya// dang po rmi lam gzung ba dang*// de nas sbyang zhing sgyu mar bslab// de tshe ya nga spang ba dang*// kho na nyid don sgom pa'o// dang po gzung ba'i man ngag ni// dran dang 'dun pas mtshams sbyar te// rnam shes srog ni 'du ba'i rten// mgrin par sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom// slar yang rlung dang shes sbyar nas// thig le bting dang bgo bar bya// de nas sbyangs pa'i man ngag ni// ngo mtshar can gyi rmi lam gang*// rmi bar bya'o snyams pa'i blos// dper na rmi lam bud med snang*// sad nas bud med mang por spro// der shes pa yis dbang gis su// cir yang bsgyur du btub pa yin// gsum pa sgyu mar bslab pa ni// bdag med ma yi rnam par bsgom// de yi sprul pa rnam mang pos// nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa// khengs par gyur pa rab bltas na// de bzhin du ni 'gyur ba yin// chos rnams rmi lam ltar shes nas// sems can don du rab tu 'jug

/sgyu ma lta bur lam khyer bas// sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang yang rgya// de dag 'chi ba'i dus byung yang*// bar do ngo ni shes par 'gyur// kho na nyid don sgom pa ni// rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i// rmi lam de ma med mthong na// rmi lam sgyu ma gcig tu sbyangs// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las// skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin man ngag 'dir// gzhi lam 'bras bu rab shes bya// rang bzhin sprin dang 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' (79)bzhin// ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs shing*// mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa// nam mkha'i dbyings nas byung nas ni// de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur// de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad ni// snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te// ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni// 'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur// de nyid 'char ba'i dus lnga ste// 'chi ba'i dus dang gnyid log dang*// mnyam par bzhag dang dbu mar gnas// mnyam rjes ro gcig gyur pa yin// ji ltar mar me bum nang gnas// phyi rol du ni snang mi 'gyur// bum pa de nyid bcag gyur na// de 'og mar me'i 'od snang 'gyur// de bzhin bum pa rang lus nyid// 'od gsal mar me lta bu yin// bla ma'i zhal gyis legs bcag na// sangs rgyas ye shes gsal bar 'gyur// stong nyid shin tu stong pa dang*// gsum pa stong pa chen po dang*// bzhi pa thams cad stong pa ni// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag go /stong pa che la mnyam par gzhag /bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min// de nyid rig la gang gis gnas// ye shes gsum ni rnam dag des// mngon par byang chub shes par 'gyur// stong pa ma yin mi stong min// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so// 'od gsal bar ni gnyid log na// zhag ni du mar mtshams bcad nas// gnyid mi nyal bar sems kyi sang*// de nas khrus dang byug pa dang*// dku mnye'i sbyor ba la 'bad cing*// mthun pa'i zas dag bsten par bya// de nas nyal bar gyur ba na// snying gi pad+mo kha phye ste// 'dab bzhi dbus kyi lte ba la// a nu ta ra hūm̐ bsgoms nas// dbugs kyi rlung ni me long la// ji ltar kun tu thim gyur pa// de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mthar// yang dang yang du 'jug par byed// ril por 'dzin pa'i rim pa dang*// de bzhin rjes su gzhig pas so// 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa na// song bzhi gcig tu gyur pa'i (80)shes// sgyu ma'i rlung ldan zung 'jug 'char// ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las// nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar// de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyur// mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'da'// bya ba byas pa'ang de nyid yin// 'chi ba stong pa chos sku la// bar ma do ni longs spyod rdzogs// srid par skye ba sprul pa'i sku// skye ba'i cha ni thabs yin la// 'gags pa shes rab srid mthar byed// dang po snang ba gsum gyis ni// thim pa'i 'od gsal ngos bzung ba// gnyis pa dag dang ma dag pas// sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas ni// bar ma dor ni 'tshang rgya'i thabs// gsum pa mngal sgo dgag pa dang*// gang 'dod mngal sgo gdam pa'o// de la skye shi bar do ru// bsgom ste sangs rgyas gtum mo dang*// sgyu ma'i lus la bslab par bya// de la goms par gyur pa dang*// rmi lam sgyu lus gnyis bsres la// rmi lam bar do sbyang bar bya// rmi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa dang*// 'chi ka dus kyi bar do ru// 'od gsal pa dang 'dres pa las// sgyu lus ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gi

/bag chags thams cad bsreg pa'i phyir// 'od gsal me yis sbyangs nas ni// zung du 'jug pa'i skur sangs rgyas// rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag gi /shes pa skye lugs 'di lta ste// snang ba thim dang rags pa thim// rtog pa thim dang phra ba thim// thim pa'i rjes la goms pa dang*// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal 'char// de yi rjes la zung 'jug gi /sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// mi slob pa ni gyur tsa na// 'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin// gang du bstan pa de dag kyang*// rgyas par bshad na 'di lta ste// dang po lung rigs man ngag gis// rgyud la rtogs pa shar tsa na// snang ba 'gag lugs bstan pa ni// gzugs ni sgra la thim par 'gyur// (81)sgra yang dri la dri yang ro// reg bya'i bar du rim gyis thim// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// de rnams rim gyis rnam shes la// rnam shes snang ba la thim tshe// phyi rtags zla shar lta bu la// nang rtags du ba lta bu 'byung*// snang ba de nyid mched pa la// thim tshe phyi rtags nyi shar 'dra// shes pa me khyer lta bur 'byung*// mched pa thob pa la thim pas// phyi rtags mun pa lta bu 'byung*// shes pa mar me lta bur 'char// thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas// phyi rtags tho rangs dus tshod kyi// skya rings shar ba lta bu 'byung*// nang gi shes pa nam mkha' ni// sprin dag 'dra ba 'char ba'o// 'od gsal de las langs pa yi// zung 'jug ngos ni gzung bya ste// mngon par byang chub 'od gsal mes// bag chags thams cad sbyong dus su// slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya'o// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed med tsa na// goms pa mthar phyin gyur ba ste// mi slob zung 'jug ces bya'o// 'bras bu thob par gyur pa yin// de las srid pa'i bar ma dor// sgyu lus zung 'jug skur gyur te// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob bo// de la goms pas mngal sgo khegs// gal te zung 'jug ma shes na// srid pa'i skye ba mi khegs pas// chags sdang snang ba kun spangs la// dran pa'i spyan pas mtshams sbyar te// mngal sgo gdam pa'i sbyor ba pa// mngon dga'i 'pho ba byas pa yis// gang 'dod gnas su skye bar 'gyur// 'pho ba'i bye brag shin tu mang*// sbyangs te 'pho dang ting 'dzin dang*// srog dang rtsol bas 'pho ba dang*// rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba dang*// btsan thabs dag tu 'pho ba dang*// spros med chos sku'i 'pho ba dang*// spros bcas gzugs sku'i 'pho ba dang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'pho ba dang*// sprul pa sku yi 'pho ba dang*// yid 'ong ḍā ki'i 'pho ba'o// de dag thams cad ro gcig (82)par// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las// pus mo skor zhing sa gol brdab// brgya dang rtsa brgyad zin pa'i mod// snying gar zin nas lkod mar gzung*// dbugs ni ngal bar gyur pa na// sna sgor cha mnyam ngal gso bya// rang 'dod dbu mar zin pa na// bde ba'i 'khor lo drang bya ste// bum pa sngon du brtsams nas ni// nyi shu rtsa gcig dbugs dag gis// gnas nas drag tu drangs nas su// gzhung tshigs nang yar pad+ma yi// 'khor lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bsam// tshigs gcig nas ni tshigs gcig go

/yar bzlog mar bzlog sa bon gyi// sbyang ba yi ge phyed dang gnyis// nga ro drag tu brjod pa yis// shes pa bde ba can du gtad// dus la bab na 'pho bya ste// dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur// rims la sogs pa ma phog par// 'pho ba'i sbyor ba mchog yin pas// 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na// mtshan ma shes par bya ba ste// lam bzang po la yid 'ongs gnas// lam ngan gyis ni srid pa skyon// thig le lte ba steng dang ni// mig sna srid sgo rna ba dang*// chu dang chu min sgo mtshan nyid// lte ba las ni 'dod khams lha// thig le'i gzugs can mtho ris te// steng nas 'gro ba steng gi ni// 'gro ba dag tu rab tu brtag /sna nas gnod sbyin gnas su ste// rna ba dag gis grub pa'i lha// gal te mig las ye shes 'phos// mi rnams kyi ni bdag por 'gyur// srid pa'i sgo las yi dwags dang*// de bzhin chu las dud 'gro ste// chu min gyis ni dmyal ba brgyad// 'di lta'i sgo yi khyad par las// 'khor ba'i bye brag tu 'gyur bas// tshangs pa'i gnas nas 'pho bar bya// nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang*// mtshams med lnga yi byed pa dang*// rku dang 'dod pas log spyod rnams// 'di yis lam gyis khegs par 'gyur// sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur te// srid pa'i dngos po ring bar 'gyur// ji ltar (83)'dam nas skyes pa yi// pad+ma'i 'dab ni mdzes par 'gyur// de bzhin 'dam 'dra'i lus dag las// ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung*// rdo rje dril bu mi ldan pa'i// rdo rje'i bsgrub par ring bar 'gyur// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// sbyangs nas pha rol brgal bar 'gyur// mtshan mo zla ba med pa yi// nyin mo zla ba ji ltar snang*// rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe// khrag 'thung dpal sogs rnal 'byor ma// lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs glu yis mchod pa yis// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed// grong du 'jug pa bshad par bya// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i 'pho ba las// bye brag gsal bar bstan pa ste// dang po sngon 'gro sbyangs nas su// dngos gzhi dmigs pa gsal ba'i tshe// sems can rma med dag la yang*// rlung sems rtsal ni sbyang bar bya// dang po khru gang bar khru gsum// tha ma khru bdun sa yin te// dmigs pa rno la ngar ldan pas// steng 'og sbo bar nus pa yis// rnal 'byor pas ni 'grub par gsungs// las la sbyar ba'i dus tshod du// dam tshig ldan pa'i grogs mchog gces// rgan po ma yin rma med cing*// mdze dang shu can la sogs spang*// shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa yis// 'byung po'i nyi ma la bsgrub bya// bdud rtsi lnga yi khyad par dang*// lha yi chu yis bkru bar byed// maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byas nas ni// de dbus 'bad pas gru gsum bya// dkyil 'khor steng du thod pa ni// mtshan ldan gcig la hūm̐ bris te// de la shes pa gtad pa dang*// gsal zhing dwangs la yang ba yi// rig pa bde ba skye bar 'gyur// rlung dang rnam par shes pa dang*// phyi rol lha dang rang nyid bsre// lus brjes sems can don bya'o// 'bras (84)bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rtog pa gnyis po spangs nas ni// gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa// zung du 'jug ces de la bshad// kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang*// don dam nyid du shes nas su// gang gis gcig tu spyod gyur pa// de yis zung 'jug shes pa'o// dngos po rnam bcas kun rtog dang*// dngos po med par rtog pa dang*// gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa zhes// rnam gnyis blo ni yod min gyi// gang du mi phyed blo yod pa// de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad// bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di gcig yin// gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag

/gnyis po gang du gcig gyur pa// de ni zung du 'jug par bshad// ril bor 'dzin dang rjes gzhig dang*// 'jug dang de bzhin gnas pa dang*// de nas gang du ldang gyur pa// mnyam gyur zung du 'jug pa'o// de nyid shes pa'i rim shes nas// bdag byin rlabs dang 'od gsal ba// de nyid la ni 'dus pa gang*// zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// chags dang chags bral las grol zhing*// mchog tu dga' ba'i lus ba ldan// 'khor ba srid du gnas byed pa// zung du 'jug par bsgom pa'o// thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas// thams cad bsdus nas shes gyur pa// rnal 'byor chen po gang du gnas// de ni zung du 'jug par 'gyur// stong nyid snying rje gcig pa ni// shes nas gang du spyod gyur pa// zung 'jug ces byar bshad pa ste// rim 'di sangs rgyas spyod yul lo// gang du lhag mar bcas pa dang*// de bzhin lhag ma med pa zhes// 'di lta'i rtog pa med gyur na// de ni zung du 'jug pa'o// gang du gang zag bdag med pa// chos la bdag med pa dag gi /rtog pa gnyis las rnam grol ba// zung du 'jug ces de la bshad// rtag dang chad pa'i blo dang ni// gang zhig spangs nas rab gnas pa'i// zung (85)du 'jug pa'i rim pa ni// de nyid shes na mkhas pa yin// kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /so so 'char ni shes nas su// gang du yang dag nges gyur pa// zung du 'jug ces de la bshad// dran dang dran min las grol zhing*// rtags 'byung ba yi mtshan nyid can// rnal 'byor pa ni 'di bzhin spyod// zung 'jug rim pa gnas pa'o// gzugs phra reg na yang ba dang*// khyab dang yang dag thob pa dang*// rab tu snang dang brtan pa dang*// dbang sgyur 'dod dgur sgyur ba ste// dbang phyug brgyad ces de la bshad// drug ni lam yin gnyis po ni// gzhan don shugs las 'byung ba yin// gnyid log pa dang sad pa ste// gnas skabs gnyis po spangs pa ni// gnyid log pa dang rnam bral ba

/zung 'jug yin bar ston pas gsungs// bya ba dang ni byed pa dag /mi phyed pa yi ngo bo nyid// gnas nas rnal 'byor pas shes pa// zung du 'jug pa de bshad do// mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag dang*// gang la 'di dag thams cad med// dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs pa// rnal 'byor pa ni zung 'jug gnas// sku dang gsung gi dbang phyug dang*// thugs dang rdzul 'phrul kun 'gro gnas// ci 'dod skyed dang yon tan rgyan// 'di ni 'bras bu'i dbang phyug brgyad// sems can dang po'i las can la// rim gyis pa 'di bstan par bya// dang po nyon mongs 'dul ba ni/ khams kyis rab tu dbye bar bya// phung po'i zhig ral bsgom par bya// bskyed rim gzhung las shes par bya// ngag dben pa dang rlung sgom pa// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// sems la dmigs pa'i man ngag ni// bde ba chen po'i man ngag go /bla ma'i zhal gyis rtogs par bya// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni// man ngag tshig bsdus dag las shes// gtum mo 'od gsal sbyang ba la// sgyu ma lta bu'i lus bsgom pa// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// slob pa la yang (86)gnyis yin te// mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang*// rang nyid lhag par gnas pa'o// mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la// gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu// me long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te// de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs// rang nyid lhag par gnas pa la// 'pho dang grong du 'jug pa dang*// rmi lam bar do rnam pa bzhi// gong du 'pho ba rnam gsum ste// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul dang ni// sgyu ma dngos dang 'od gsal lo// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul la ni// k+ṣuṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge yis// bu ga dag kyang dgag bya ste// rang gi sems ni lha yi sku// 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom pa'ang*// yang na hūm̐ la bsdu bya ste// tshangs pa'i bu ga dag tu 'don// 'og min gnas su yang dang yang*// rgyun mi 'chad par gnas par bya// de ltar goms pa brtan gyur na// dus kyi rtags rnams shes bya ste// 'pho kar shes pa gnas su bskyal// de ltar byas pas 'pho bar 'gyur// sgyu ma dngos kyi 'pho ba ni// 'og nas 'byung ba'i rmi lam la// goms par bya ste sum cu ni// rtsa gsum gnas su 'pho bar bya// de ru sngar ni gang bsgoms par// goms pas khrid de bsgoms gyur na// bde stong skye ba'i gnad yin pas// mi rtog ye shes thob nas ni// tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid// thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// sngags pa'i 'gro sa mchog yin te// mtshan nyid pa ni ltung bar 'gyur// 'od gsal ba yi 'phro ba ni// 'pho ba'i dus ni shes byas te// mi rtog pa la sems gnas nas// lus kyi rtsol ba dag gis ni// 'od gsal bar ni gzhug bya ste// bar dor mya ngan 'da' ba yin// bslabs nas 'pho ba de rnams yin// 'od gsal ba la sems gnas na// slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che// ma bslabs par yang 'pho ba yod// zung 'jug ting 'dzin la gnas (87)nas// slar ni gang la'ang mi slob ste// gnyis med rtogs pa mthar phyin pa// sku bzhi ro mnyam 'gyur ba'o// de la grong du 'jug pa ni// mdun du dmigs pa gsal byas la// dbugs dang shes pa 'thon par gtad// de la dmigs pa byang pa dang*// dmigs pa je gsal je gsal 'gyur// de la yun du goms byas nas// rang gi phung po dor bya ste// bsod nams can gyi lus blangs nas// sems can don ni ma lus bya// rmi lam la yang rnam lnga ste// dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang*// spyad dang goms par 'khrid pa dang*// gong du 'pho bar shes par bya// dran pa shes bya'i sgo la ni// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// 'dun pa dag ni mngon btang nas// log ka ma yi shes pa ni// dran pas yang dang yang dgug la// dgug pas log re lan re bzhin// rab rib sad dus 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltar dran pa brtan gyur nas// sgyu ma dag tu shes bya ste// ma log pa yi dus su yang*// snang srid sgyu mar shes bya'o// sgyu ma dngos ni rmi lam yin// sgyu ma lta bur shes bya ste// 'di nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas// bar do sgyu mar ma shes nas// bar do'i srid pas mi khegs pas// skye ba yang dang yang blangs te// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin// de ltar rmi lam dngos dag la// blo ni 'jug tu ma btub na// sngon du 'gro ba dag bya ste// ma log pa yi dus su yang*// snang srid sgyu mar shes par bya// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rtags brtan dang*// 'du 'dzi shin tu nyung ba dang*// sngar gyi goms par khrid pa dang*// mos pa shin tu drags pa dang*// dgug pa'i dus dag shes pa'o// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// dran pa de nyid sgyu ma ru// shes bya snyam pa sngon btang la// nan tan du ni bsgom par bya// de ltar du ni goms pa dang*// phan tshun dag tu phyin pa dang*// ngal dub dag ni 'ong ba dang*// 'grangs (88)ltog dag ni 'ong ba dang*// cho 'phrul dag ni ston pa dang*// de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams// ma log pa yi dus su yang*// goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyis// log ka ma yi dus su ni// mtshan mo'i dran pa de rnyed la// bag mi tsha bar dpyad par bya// de ltar sgyu mar yang dang yang*// nyin mtshan dag tu bsams nas su// sgyu mar shes pa'i mtshan ma ni// ya nga ba dang bag mi tsha// sprul bsgyur nus pa dam dum 'byung*// de ltar goms pa brtan par bya// de ltar brtan par gyur nas ni// 'pho ba dag ni bya bar bshad// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// sems ni gang dgar btang ba dang*// 'gro sar sems ni btang byas nas// log ka ma yi dus su yang*// de ring bag chags dran byas te// de ltar rang gi rig pa yis// dpyad cing gang ltar bde bar 'pho// 'pho bar brtan par gyur nas ni// sgyu mar sbyangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// sngar gyi goms pa bgyid par bya// log kar yang dang yang du bsgom// de ltas rmi lam sbyang dus su// dam dum bag re 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltas rmi lam sbyong ba la// gang yang bzang ngan mi lta ste// rtags ma byung bar zin pa yod// rang gi rig pas rtogs bya ba// ma rtogs pa na 'bad cing brtag

/rtsol ba dag ni bskyed byas la// nyes pa tshar ni gcad par bya// de ltar yang dang yang byas pas// mod du zin pa dag kyang yod// longs spyod la sogs rgyud sbyangs pas// lo yis zin pa dag kyang yod// ye ma zin pa dag kyang yod// de ltar yang dang yang goms pas// rmi lam byin gyis rlob pa yin// de yis bar do rlob par 'gyur// gong ma'i rmi lam goms pa yis// 'chi ga'i shes pa gsal byas te// 'chi ga'i rtags rnams tshang ba dang*// sngar goms pa la sems gzhag ste// 'od gsal bar ni 'jug par bya// 'chi gar gnyid mi log pa na// (89)dran pa dag ni sngon btang nas// sa bon skye gnas rim khyab pa// gzhi dang khang pa nyid dang ni// las la sbyor ba rang nus la// rang gi ngo bo thig ler bcas// bcu gnyis mtha' yi tshig gi don// rang gis rtag tu goms gyur na// des ni dngos grub bde ba yis// rdo rje 'dzin par rang nyid 'gyur// skye ba snga ma'i lus bor yang*// sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can// las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// bar do de yis mig snga ru// thabs dang shes rab mthong ba la// bla ma dag tu dmigs byas te// gsang ba'i dbang ni dran byas nas// mig ser zhe sdang kun spangs te// bde gsal mi rtog sgom pa'am// yang na sngon du gang bsgoms pa'i// goms pa khrid de bsgom par bya// dus su dran par gyur nas ni// dang po'i srid pa khegs par 'gyur// de nas bdun phrag drug gi bar// gong ma bzhin du goms byas pas// bzhi bcu rtsa dgu 'das pa dang*// 'khor ba'i srid pa khegs pa yin// de ltar sgyu mar gnas pa la// 'od gsal ba yis sbyangs byas te// 'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur// dpal rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis gsungs pa gtsigs kyi rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab pa rdzogs so/// bla ma til+li pas 'og min gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa jo bo nā ro pa dang*/

mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ kar+ṇa tan+t+ra badz+ra pa dā ki nā ma/ bod skad du/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /

gdams pa zab mo'i gling gzhi/ /e ma ho// sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba'i mchog /ye shes rgyal po theg pa mchog gi lam// tshig tu brjod pa kun dang bral ba'i (90)don// theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// rdo rje 'chang ngas skal ldan don du bshad// gus btud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon/ ༈ / gdams pa'i sngon 'gro// thog mar brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ /bslab gsum rgyan ldan nyams myong bla ma'i mchog /dad brtson shes rab snying rje slob ma'o// nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang*/ ༈ /dngos gzhi smin byed dbang*// gnyis pa smin lam 2yid bzhin nor bu/ /thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas// drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur// lha mo bco lnga dbang bzhi brda yis mtshon// smin par byas nas gsum pa grol lam 3yid bzhin nor bu/ thabs shes zung du sbrel/ ༈ / bum dbang lam bskyed rim/ /rgyal po blon sogs rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad/ ces pa rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag yab yum gyi bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus pa// blon po rigs gsum las byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor/1 dbang 2blang ba/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/3 dam pa phrin las mthun sbyor/ zas 1 gos 2 gnyid 3 bskong ba 4 smra brjod 5 khrus 6 gtor ma7'o/ /bsre ba ro snyoms dam tshig gsum la sbyar// ces pa bskyed rim sogs snang ba gdod nas skye med stong pa'i rtsal du shes pas bsre ba/ de ltar shes nas bsgom pa ro snyoms/ sku 1bum dbang*/ gsung 2gsang dbang*/ thugs 3sher dbang*/ bzhi pa'i dam tshig go ༈ /gsang dbang lam steng sgo rnam grol chos drug / gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung*// lus gnad bdun ldan lha sku'i stong ra gnad// dhū tī la la ra sa 'khor lo bzhi// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol thur sel gcud// rdo rje bzlas pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom// zin dang brtan nas shes rab snyoms par 'jug

/dga' bzhi goms pas rtsa rlung thig le 'dres// dhū tīr rlung sems tshud pas mi rtog pa// nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad// ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du gnas/ ༈ /bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la// 'khor 'das thams cad (91)sgyu mar shes byas te// sgyu ma'ang 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'o// da ltar snang ba dngos po'i chos rnams ni// bden cing rtag na 'gyur bar ga la rigs// 'khrul gzugs yin phyir don la grub pa med// gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag car ltos// gnyis 'dzin zhig pas chags sdang kun dang bral// de ltar shes pas sna tshogs zhen med spyod// 'ja' lus chos sku thob par 'gyur ro kye/ ༈ /mtshan dus rmi lam 'khrul ba rang sangs la// sgo gsum 'bad pa dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung*// 'dzin sbyang spel bsgyur sprul cing gegs rnams sel// nyi zla zhon dang zhing khams mtha' dag bgrod// bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol ltos// mthar phyin sa bcu non nas don chen thob/ ༈ /khyad par 4'od gsal ma rig mun bral la// lus gnad thabs ldan ting 'dzin bzhi la sbyor/ ces pa/ snying gar nyi zla'i steng bla ma yi dam rang sems dbyer med dbus su thig le sngo/ phyogs bzhir phyogs mdog ste thig le lnga/1 de gnas bsgyur te rim par sa 2bon hūm̐ dang a nu ta ra/ phyag 3mtshan/ rigs lnga'i sku 4rnams la rim bzhin sems gzung ba'o// thig le gus ldan dug gsum 'dzin med ltos// gnyid dang rmi lam rnam rtog bar nas bzung*// rim pa bzhi dang nyin mtshan bsre zhing goms// gsal stong 'dzin bral lhan rim pa bzhin sems la sbyar na/ sems gsal stong du gnas pa las rtsal shar ba snang ba/ de la rtog dpyod zhugs pa mched pa/ dgag sgrub tu shor ba thob pa/ chags sdang rmongs pa'i rtog pa rags pa nyer thob/ de rnams lugs 'byung du shes/ lugs ldog tu thim pas 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur ba'o//

skyes ye shes de// brjod du med pa 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad// mi rtogs sbyang zhing phyag rgya chen por blta/ ༈ /'pho ba 5gser 'gyur ma bsgom sangs rgyas ni// 'chi ltas shar tshe dga' zhing zhen pa btang*// sgo dgu bgag la rdzas dang smon lam rgyan// hūm̐ dang rlung sems dbyer med dhū tīr (92)drangs// k+ṣa yig bsal la tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phang*// chos sku bla ma rgyal ba'i zhing du 'pho/ ༈ /lhag par grong 'jug 6sbrul lpags 'dor len ni// rlung sems dbang thob bskyed rdzogs brtan pa yis// skyon med ro la rnam shes yig 'bru 'phang dgos pa khyad par can gyi dus skyon med pa'i phung po yul phung po gsar rnying gnyis ka'i tshangs bug bye ba rdzas dang grogs nyams can sogs gnad shes mngon du gyur// the tshom bral ba'i skyes bu gzhan don spyod/ ༈ /sher dbang lam 'og sgo bde ba chen po/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam bde ba chen po ni// bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma ni// pad+ma ri dwags dung can la sogs pa// phyag rgya mtshan ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// skal ldan skyes bu he ru ka lta bu// gnyis med 'khril sbyor zag bcas zag med rol// thig le dbab bzung bzlog dgram gnas su spel// bya rgod bcud la seng ge glang chen dang*// rma bya stag mo rus sbal la sogs bya// dga' ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis don la blta// lhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin dbyer med ston// snang srid thams cad zag med bde bar 'char// gsang dbang phyag rgya bdud rtsi ril bu'i phyir// thig le bcu drug phyed phyed bzhi cha sbyin// bzhi gsum 'khor lo dag la dgram par bya// bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos// don la nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung*// des na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med/ ༈ / dbang bzhi pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed/

/phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed ni// sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga har dngas gzhag /bltas pas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos// dmigs su med pas ma bcos rang sor gzhag /gzhan du ma tshol ngo bo rtogs par gyis// gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na// 'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i klongs yangs su// (93)skye shi med pa chos sku'i lus mthong 'gyur// phyi rol yul sems chos rnams ji snyed pa// rang sems yin phyir gzhan na grub pa med// 'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin sna tshogs gang shar rnams// cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang brlag ltos// sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku// 'gag med gsal dngas gang shar sprul pa'i sku// gnas med bde chen zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// phyag ni gnyis med ye shes ngo yis zin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa bral bas bde// chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams pa las// gzhan gyis ma yin rang grol chos sku'o// sgrib gnyis rang dag gzung 'dzin mtha' dang bral// 'du shes blo dang 'khor 'das chos rnams zad// mkhyen tshad yon tan ji snyed rang la rdzogs// bsam brjod blo 'das sangs rgyas rang 'khrungs yin/ ༈ /lam blo nas gcod par bar do ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag /bar do ngo sprod yang dag zab don bstan// skye shi rmi lam sred pa'i bar do gcod// bltar med bltas pas mthong med mthong ba'i mchog /rang rig gsal stong mi rtog sgrib g.yogs bral// bde chen chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rang bzhin dbyer med sku gsum rang shar ltos// ma rtogs lus ldan bar do rnam gsum la// bskyed rim sgyu lus 'od gsal chos skur 'dre// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rim gyis thim// brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te// dkar dmar sems gsum chu skyes nang du 'joms// 'od gsal ngos 'dzin ma bu dbyer med 'dre// chos skur sangs rgyas dbang po yang rab bo// de ma zin na rlung gsum rkyen gyis 'ching*// 'bring ba chu la nya ltar longs skur 'gyur// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'od zer lnga dug gsum las kyi dbang*// chags sdang gnyis kyis mngal du 'jug 'gyur bas// bsre ba lnga ldan lam khyer phyag rgya bzhi//

zhes pas 'dod chags gtum mo// (94) zhe sdang sgyu lus/ gti mug 'od gsal/ nga rgyal bskyed rim/ phrag dog dag snang dang bsre ba lnga/ dam rgya thun mong yid bzhin nor bu/ chos rgya steng sgo/ las rgya 'og sgo/ phyag chen ye shes gsal byed de dbang bzhi'i lam mo// sngar sbyangs ldan pas bar do rang grol 'gyur// tha ma chags sdang grol nas sprul sku thob/ ༈ /gdams pa spyi'i gegs sel bogs 'don/ /gdams pa spyi la gegs bsal bar chad kyi ngos nyid bzung*/ zhing sel ba/ rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu yi/ zhes pa'i rtsa ba drug ni/ sing ge bsgyings/ glang chen 'gyings/ rma bya 'phur/ stag mo sgyugs/ ru sbal bskum/ bya rog 'phur ba'i 'khrul 'khor ro// yan lag so dgu ni/ rgyal mtshan 'khrud ces yan lag bzhi 'khrud pa ltar byas te lus la byugs pa sogs so// rdo rje lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad du bsnun// bya spyod thams cad tshogs su bsgyur bar bya/ ༈ 'bras bu ji ltar thob tshul/ /go rim ma nor nyams su blangs gyur na// skad cig bzhi la dga' ba gsum ston te// dwangs ma yas byon 'gyu ba mas brtan pa// rtsa mdud rim pas grol nas dhū tīr 'gyur// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga// rlung dang nyon mongs 'gags nas ye shes 'gyur// gnas dang nyi gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs// pūl+li ma ru yan chad gang bar 'gyur// sprul sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhal ston cing*// mngon shes yon tan brgyad dang ther 'bum thob// dus 'dir sa lam rim par bgrod byed de// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ ༈ gdams pa bka' rgyas gdab pa/ /bcu gsum bar du chig brgyud rgya yis gdab// mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po 'di yin pas// skal ldan grol phyir gsang ba'i nges don mdzod// ces ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la gdams pa// snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga dang*/

lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis puṣ+pa ha ri'i gnas chen tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// (95) 'di ni rje btsun mi la'i thugs bcud bde mchog snyan brgyud du grags pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las// rgyas pa ras chung snyan brgyud du grags pa'i gdams ngag gi rtsa ba yin cing*/ snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i dam pa snga phyir byon pa rnams kyis spyi don/ sa bcad/ 'grel pa/ khrid yig sogs rgya cher mdzad snang ngo*// grub chen na ro pa'i gdams ngag chos drug skor gyi bka' dpe tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// rim gyis pa dang gcig car ba// rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di// gcig car ba yi dug chen yin// gcig car ba yi sman chen de// rim gyis pa zur mang snyan brgyud yi dug tu 'gyur// des na sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la// gcig car pa ni bstan par bya// sems can dang po'i las can la// rim gyis pa ni bstan par bya// dang po'i nyon mongs 'dul ba ni/ khams kyis rab tu dbye bar bya// phung po gzhig grol bsgom par bya// bskyed rim gzhung la sbyar bar bya// ngag dben rlung ni bsgom pa'i thabs// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni// man ngag tshig bsdus dag las shes// sgyu ma lta bu'i lus bsgoms pa// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// slob pa la yang rnam gnyis te// mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang*// rang gis lhag par gnas pa'o// mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la// gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu// me long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te// de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs// zhes bya ba sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis la sogs kyis rtogs par bya'o// da ni lhag par gnas pa la// grong du 'jug dang 'pho ba dang*// rmi lam bar do rnam pa bzhi// de la grong du 'jug pa ni// mdun du dmigs pa gsal byas la// dbugs dang sems ni ma yengs par// gtad nas yun tu goms byas na// shes pa byang nas je gsal 'gyur// de la yun (96)du goms byas na// rang gi phung po dor byas nas// bsod nams can gyi lus blangs te// sems can don ni ma lus byas// grong du 'pho ba rnam gsum ste// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul dang ni// sgyu ma dngos dang 'od gsal lo// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul la ni// k+ṣuṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge yis// bu ga dag kyang dgag byas te// rang gi sems ni lha yi sku// 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom pa'am// yang na hūm̐ la bsdu bya ste// tshangs pa'i bu ga nas bton te// 'og min gnas su yang dang yang*// rgyun mi 'chad par gnas par bya// de ltar goms pa brtan gyur nas// dus dang rtags rnams shes bya ste// 'pho kar shes pa gnas su bskyal// de ltar byas pas thob par 'gyur// sgyu ma dngos kyi 'pho ba ni// 'og nas 'byung ba'i rmi lam la// goms par bya ste sum cu ni// rtsa gsum gnas su 'pho bya ste// de ru sngar du gang goms pa'i// goms pas khrid de goms gyur na// bde ba skyed pa'i gnas yin pas// mi rtog ye shes thob nas ni// tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas na// 'thab 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// sngags pa'i 'gro sa mchog yin no// mtshan nyid pa ni ltung bar 'gyur// 'od gsal bar ni 'pho ba la// 'chi ba'i dus ni shes byas la// me tog pa la sems gnas na// lus kyi rtsol ba dag gis ni// 'od gsal bar ni 'jug pa ste// bar dor mya ngan 'das pa yin// bslab nas 'pho ba de rnams yin// ma bslabs par yang 'pho ba yod// /

༈ /gtum mo'i bka' dpe'o// bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma chen po nā ro pas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni// 'bum phrag bdun ni bzlas pa yis// sa rnams g.yos shing lung bstan thob// shar phyogs ngos kyi te lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni// dngos po'i (97)gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// de la dngos po'i gnas lugs ni// lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// de la gnad ni rnam pa gsum// lus dang yul dang dbang po gsum// de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa// rin chen rtsar la brgyus pa ltar// shin tu bsrang la dgugs par byed// li ri bzhin tu khong bsgrim bya// rgya mdud lta bu'i tshul du gnas// 'phel ka shin tu bskyed par bya// mnyam bzhag rgya yis btsir bya zhing*// re'u mig ltar ni bsnol bar bya// rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phang dang rnam bzhi'o// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen// de ni lus kyi gnad du gsungs// yul gyi gnad ni rnam gnyis te// phyi nang gnyis su bshad par bya// phyi yi dkar dmar rnam pa can// nang du 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi// de la thabs lam bgrang mi lang*// de ni yul gyi gnad yin no// da ni dus kyi gnad

g.yas g.yon 'pho dus zer ba'ang yod/ mchan/ bshad pa// gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug dang*// tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi// de la dus bzhi'i nyams len ni// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// de la dus kyi gnad brtag go /thabs lam khyad par 'phags pa ste/ bla ma tai lo pas bla ma nā ro pa la gnang des mar pa la gnang des gung thar gi mi la thos pa dga' la gnang*// de las 'bras bu rim gyis 'byung*// 'bras bu 'byung ba'i 'byung tshul ni// lus dang man ngag nyams dang gsum// rim pa grangs kyis 'byung bar gsungs// dper na seng ge'i 'o ma 'di/ /gser snod dngul snod ma yin pa// snod ngan phal la byin pa na// dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro// des na gsang ba thub par gyis// grub thob brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di// rang gis nyams su blang bar bya// rgya mtsho'i gting gi rdo (98)ba bzhin// kha ru dbyung pha ma yin no// / ༈ /rmi lam bka' dpe'o// na mo gu ru// rmi lam la yang rnam lnga ste// dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang*// sbyang dang goms par bya ba dang*// gong du 'pho bar shes par bya// dran pa zhes bya bsgom pa ni// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// 'dun pa dag ni sngon btang ste// log ka ma yi shes pa ni// dran pas sang yang bskul byas la// bskul bar log rer lan re 'dzin// rab rib
