yad yud 'byang bar 'gyur// de ltar dran pa brtan gyur na// sgyu ma dag tu shes byas te// ma log pa yi dus su yang*// snang srid sgyu mar shes bya ste// sgyu ma dngos ni rmi lam yin// de nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas// bar do sgyu mar mi shes nas// bar do'i srid pa mi khegs pas// skye ba yang dang yang blang ste// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin// de ltar rmi lam dngos dag las// blo ni 'jug tu ma btub na// sngon du 'gro ba dag byas te// bskyed rim bzlas pa'i rtags dag dang*// 'du 'dzi shin tu nyung ba dang*// sngar gyi goms pa dkri ba dang*// mos pa shin tu drags pa dang*// bskul ba'i dus dag shes pa'o// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// dran pa de nyid sgyu ma ru// shes bya'i bsam pa sngon btang la// nan tan du ni sbyang bar bya// de ltar du ni bsgom pa dang*// phan tshun dag tu phyin pa dang*// ngal dub dag ni ngal dub med// 'grangs ltog dag ni 'ong ba dang*// cho 'phrul dag ni bstan pa dang*// de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// goms par bya yi bar chad kyis// log ka ma yi dus su yang*// mtshan ma dran pa de rnyed la// bag mi tsha bar spyad par bya// de ltar sgyu mar yang dang yang*// nyin mtshan gtan tu bsam nas kyang*// sgyu mar shes pa'i mtshan ma ni// ya mi nga dang bag mi tsha// dam dum kem keṃ ya 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltar (99)brtan par goms par bya// de ltar brtan par gyur na ni// 'pho ba dag ni bya bar bshad// gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang*// rang bzhin gang dgar btang bar bya// 'gro sar sems ni btang byas nas// log ka ma yi dus su yang*// der ni bag chags dran byas te// de ltar rang gi rig pa yis// dpyad cing gong ltar rig pa 'pho// 'pho ba brtan par gyur nas ni// sgyu ma sbyangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// sngar gyi goms pa dkri bar bya// da ltar snga ma ci bzhin bsgom// log kar yang dang yang du bsgom// de ltar rmi lam dus su ni// dam dum yad yud 'byung bar 'gyur// gang la'ang bzang ngan mi blta ste// rmi lam 'od gsal 'pho nus pa// rtags ma byung bar 'phyangs pa yod// rang gis rig pas rtogs byas pa// ma rtogs na yang 'bad cing brtags// rtsol ba dag ni bskyed byas la// shes pa tshar ni bcad par bya// de ltar yang dang yang byas pas// mod du zin pa dag kyang yod// zla bas zin pa dag kyang yod// lo yis zin pa dag kyang yod// yang dang yang du goms byas pas// rmi lam byin gyis rlobs pa yin// de yis bar do bslang bar 'gyur// gong ma'i rmi lam goms pa yis// 'chi kha'i shes pa gsal byas te// 'chi ba'i rtags rnams tshang ba dang*// sngar goms pa la'ang sems bzhag ste// 'od gsal ba la 'jug pa'am// yang na gsal ba la mi 'jug

/'chi kar gnyid ni log pa na// dran pa dag ni sngon btang nas// sa bon skyes nas rim khyab bo// gzhi dang khang pa nyid dag dang*// las dang pha rol sbyor ba dang*// rang lus ngo bo thig le bcas// bcu gnyis mtha' yi tshig gi don// gang gis rtag tu bsgom gyur na// de yi dngos grub bde ba yi// rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid 'gyur/ rdzogs so/// /(100)༈ /'od gsal gyi bka' dpe'o// nā ro pa'i gdams pa la// phung po khams dang skye mched dbang po la// shes pa gnyis po 'di ltar bsdus byas pas// stong chen 'gyur bas gang zhig gnyid log pa// rlung gi shugs kyis rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur// rmi lam sad pas bye brag gzhan med pas// kun tu rtog pas rmi lam phral 'dod pas// 'gro ba nyin mtshan nye bar gnyid log cing*// sa sdug gyur pas rab tu rang gnyid log /sems dang sems las 'byung ba'i rtog tshogs ni// rang grol bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin no// de ni sgyu ma'i dpe yis nye bar mtshon te// de bas na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu dang*// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus ngag ni// de nyid bsgoms pas 'thob par 'gyur// ma rig pa dang gis 'gags shing*// 'od gsal ba la 'gro'o// phyi nas langs nas rlung gis 'khor bar 'gyur ba ste/ des lus grub nas mig la sogs pa'i dbang po yul dmigs pa de srid du// de nyid du mi dmigs par mi 'gyur ste// thog med dus nas gom phyir ro// phung po la sogs khams phra ba la gzhug go /khams ni sems phra ba la gzhug go /sems yang ma rig pa la gzhug ste// de ltar gnyid log par bya'o// phyis ni ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// ma rig pa de lcags kyu dang 'dra// rnam par shes pa gang la'ang 'dre bar mi byed do// 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo nyid mngon sum du byed do// skye ba 'dis sangs rgya'o// bcas rang gar 'dod pa'i zhing khams khyad par can du 'gro na yang 'gro'o/

/tai lo pas gsungs/ des nā ro pa la/ des mar pa la/ des mi la la/ des rin po che la gnang ba'o/ /gnyid dang 'dres pa'i bsam gtan rdzogs so// ༈ /bar do'i bka' dpe'o// bla ma grub thob rnams (101)la phyag 'tshal lo// rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag ni// shes pa'i skye lugs 'di lta ste// snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim// rags pa thim dang phra ba thim// thim rjes la ni goms pa dang*// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'byung*// de yi rjes la zung 'jug gi /sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// mi slob pa ru gyur ce na// 'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin// gong du bstan pa de dag ni// zhib tu byas na 'di lta ste// dang po lung rigs man ngag gis// rgyud la rtog pa shar tsam na// snang ba 'gags pa'i 'gags lugs ni// gzugs sgra la thim de bzhin du// dri dang ro dang reg bya dang*// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// de rnams rim gyis snang bar thim// snang ba'i dus na phyi rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu// nang rtags ni shes pa du ba lta bu'o// snang ba mched pa la thim tsam na// phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu// nang shes pa srin bu me khyer ba lta bu'o// mched pa thob pa la thim tsam na// phyi rtags mun pa lta bu/ nang shes pa mar me lta bu'o// thob pa 'od gsal la thim tsam na// phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu/ nang shes pa nam mkha' sprin dag pa lta bu'o// 'od gsal las ldang ba'i zung 'jug gi sku de ngo shes par byas te// ngo shes pa ni gsum ste/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang*/ zung 'jug gi sku dang*/ mngal gyi skye gnas dgag pa'o/ 'od gsal ba de ngos zin nas 'od gsal gyi mes bag chags thams cad sbyong ba'i dus na// slob pa'i zung 'jug zhes bya'o// de sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed med par goms pa mthar phyin tsam na/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug zhes bya ste 'bras bu thob pa'o// zung 'jug de ngos zin na bar do sgyu ma'i lus yin te// de'i mtshan nyid ni// dbang po kun tshangs thogs med ldan// la sogs pa gzhan nas bshad pa dang mthun te/

chu las nya ldang ba bzhin byung nas/ skye ba gzhan len pa la sogs pa sdug (102)bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ro// / bar do lam du byed pa 'chi ka ma'i dus su bslab pa ni 'byung ba bzhi rim gyis thim par shes par byas la/ rang gi sems la bltas shing bar do la bar do ngo shes par bya'o snyam pa'i 'du shes drag tu bya zhing*/ bar do de nyid kyang sgyu mar shes par byas shing de kho na nyid bsgom ste/ skye ba'i rkyen pa ma la chags sdang skye ba yin pas/ de zlog cing 'od gsal du gnas par bya'o// de'i dus su de kho na bsgom par mi nus shing skye ba len na'ang*/ rang dbang gis bde ba can tu 'gro bar bya ste rang dbang yod par lus len pa'o// de ni bar do lam du khyer ba ste/ shes bzhin tu 'jug pa'i gang zag go // rdo rje 'chang gis phyag na rdo rje la/ des tai lo pa la/ des nā ro pa la/ des rje btsun mar pa la/ des gung thang gi mi la thos pa dga' ba des rin po che la gnang*/ snyan nas snyan/ zhal nas zhal/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa'o// kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'o// rin po che'i gdams pa'o// rdzogs so/ ༈ /grong 'jug gi bka' dpe'o// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de la sems kyi 'pho ba grong khyer la 'jug pa'i man ngag ni/ 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ dang po rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad sgyu ma dang khyad med pa'i don la mos pa drag po bya/ de nas rang gi khyim du maṇ+ḍal legs par byugs te/ thod pa'am// g.yam pa rtse ni la chang byugs te/ dbus su hūm̐ dkar po gsal bar bris te maṇ+ḍal gyi thog tu bzhag la/ rang gi shes pa snying gar hūm̐ la gtad par byas la/ rang gi dbugs dang shes pa hūm̐ la gtad de drag tu bzung ngo*// de nas zin pa'i rtags ni thod pa dro ba'am/ 'gul ba'am// 'phang ba'am/ du ba'i rtags 'ong ste/ de'i rjes la mi shi nas ring po ma lon pa/ ro ma rul ba rma med pa blangs la khrus byas te/

rgyan btags la yid gzhung bar bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi thog tu bzhag /ro'i snying gar hūm̐ bsam la de la shes pa gtad la (103)dbugs thub tshad bzung ngo*// de nas rlung dang shes pa ro la zin nas dga' ba skyes shing 'dug tsam na/ shes pa ro'i snying gar hril te gtad de bcug la/ tshur mi drang bar/ de langs la lus snga ma bor ro// grong du 'jug pa slob pa'o// / ༈ /'pho ba'i bka' dpe'o// 'pho ba ni de kho na nyid dang*/ grong khyer du 'pho ba gnyis te/ de kho na nyid kyi 'pho ba ni/ rang nyid lhar bsgom pa'i snying ga'am/ lte bar pad+ma dang zla ba dang hūm̐ bsam ste/ de'i 'od kyis snang srid thams cad rang sku la bsdu/ sku yang hūm̐ dang zla ba la bsdu/ zla ba yang hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar bsdus la mthar dbugs chad pa dang dus mnyam du nā da'ang mi dmigs par bya'o// des ni rang gi rlung gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ mos pa dang rtsol ba drag po dang*/ snang srid sgyu ma tsam du yid ches pas/ ci ltar yang btub snyams pas 'byung ba yin no// // de la grong du 'pho bar byed na yang*/ bar do chos thams cad sgyu ma dang 'dra ba la yid ches par bya'o// de yang gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag la gsum te/ ting nge 'dzin gyis dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ btsan thabs so// de la ting nge 'dzin gyis 'pho ba byed na/ dang po rlung la sbyang ste/ de yang*/ rang gi snying gar yi ge haṃ yig zer ba'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad yun thub tshad du bzung*/ dbugs ngal na yang sna rtse la phar la rlung drang ngo// de nas snying gar bzung zhing yang dang yang du nan tan du goms par byas pas ci tsam 'dod par zin cing*/ rang dbang yod pa snyam byed pa 'ong ngo*// pus mo bskor zhing se gol brdab// brgya rtsa brgyad zin pa'i chad ces gsungs so// snying gar zin nas lkog mar bzung bar bya'o// de ltar dbugs ngal na sna sgor ngal gso/

der ni gang 'dod zin gyur na// bde ba'i 'khor lo drangs byas te// shes pa bde ba can du gtad la tshangs pa'i sgo nas 'pho (104)bar bya// // rtsol bas 'pho ba 'di ltar bya ste/ dang po 'chi rtags byung nas mi thar par shes nas dang por chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu la yid ches par byas la/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bca' ba'o// de yang ngag tu ā li bzlas te ngag gi 'khrul 'khor bcas pa'o// de nas shes pa bde ba can du gtad de bsam pa der btang la rang gi shes pa snying gar hūm̐ la bsdus te/ lag pa ltad par sprel te pus mo btsugs la/ snying gyen la log par bsams la/ lus dbyug pa la brten te/ ngag tu yang hi ka byas pas kha nas 'pho bar bya// 'chi rtags nges na 'pho bya ste// 'chi rtags med na sangs rgyas gsod/ 'pho ba bo// de la btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba ni// rkang pa g.yon pa'i phyi rting gis bshang sgo dgag /long bus rtsa sgo mnan nas de la/ seng ge rnam 'gying gi phyag rgyas rtse'u chung gnyis dang mig la sogs pa mnan/ 'og sgo bsdam zhing rlung bum pa can tu bya'o// de nas dbugs ma thub na gru mo gnyis kyis mchan khung 'og gi rtsibs log bsdam la/ sked pa nyeg par byas te/ rlung drag por gyen du drangs te phul nas yar rlung dang shes pa gnyis khrog gis phyur gyis tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'phos te mkha' spyod du 'gro ba'o// 'pho ba 'di gar dgar dgar bya mi rung ste/ rang gi lus kyi lha bsad na mtshams med rtsa ltung 'byung nas ngan song du 'gro'o// 'chi nges na gong rol du bya'o// khyad par du btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba 'di ni sdig po che tshogs ma bsags pas bya'o// gzhan tu mi rung ngo*// // dang po rang nyid skyil mo krung dang mnyam bzhag bcas te// mig sna rtser phab la/ skad cig gis yi dam lhar bsgom la/ rlung drag po nang du rngub cing drangs nas bum pa can lta bur bya'o// 'og sgo dang steng sgo gnyis char gyis bsdab/

de nas lte ba a snying gar hūm̐ bsam la/ de nas shes pa snying las zhugs (105)te// hūm̐ gyen tu song nas tshangs pa'i srubs 'byed bzhin 'byed par bsam// de la dbugs shin tu ma thub na// sna g.yon pa nas bag tsam btang zhing de nyid la bsgom// de la 'pho bar nus pa'i tshad ni// dbugs re la lag pa pus mo'i 'khor gsum bskor zhing se gol lan gsum gsum brdab// brgya rtsa brgyad nus na 'pho bar nus so// na mthun gtong tsam na// yi ge gnyis gnas su song bar bsam 'chi nges na gong rol du 'pho'o// de la 'pho ba'i dus su gong du bsgom pa ltar byas te// sked pa cung zad nyeg nyeg por byas nas// gru mos rtsibs logs gnyis cung zhig mnan te// rlung drag po gyen du drangs te// tshangs pa'i srub phyes te 'phos pas// shes pa rlung dang gnyis khrog ther gyis 'gro'o// 'pho ba'i man ngag go tai lo pa/ des nā ro pa/ des lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros// des gung thang gi mi la thos pa dga' la// des rin po che sgam po pa la gnang ba'o// grub pa nus pa thob pa'i nyams len rgyun ma chad pa yin no// rje btsun ras pa ni mkha' 'gro mas kyang byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsungs so/

// ༈ /gdams ngag gnad kyi bka' dpe'o// srog rtsol gnad du bsdams byas te// rtsa rlung thig le mtshan ldan dang*// 'od gsal rjes su gnang ba bsgom// srog rtsol dag la dbang thob na// rlung ni g.yas g.yon 'pho dus dang*// kha dog bye brag tshor ba dang*// bsdam gdod med cing phyi nang bsre// tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags byung nas// dgos dgu thams cad 'byung bar gsungs// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams blangs na// dam tshig de yis skong bar gsungs// rmi lam mngon sum gang la yang*// cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung ba la// sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gyur// bden par bzung na bar chod yin// nyin re bram ze brgya gsod dang*// mtshams med lnga dag byed pa dang*// rku dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams// (106)'di yi lam gyis 'gags par 'gyur// sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur te// srid pa'i dngos por rengs par 'gyur// ji ltar 'dam nas skyes pa yi// pad+ma'i mdangs ni mdzes par 'gyur// de bzhin rgas pa'i lus dag la// ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung*// rdo rje sbyor ba'i sbyor bas na// rdo rje dril bu mi ldan pa'i// gsang ba'i 'bras bu ci ltar 'byung*// rdo rje dril bu mi ldan pa'i// rdo rje bsgrub pa rengs par 'gyur// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// sbyangs nas pha rol dga' bar 'gyur// mtshan mo zla ba med pa yi// nyin mo zla ba ji ltar snang*// // ces nā ro pa'i bka' dpe rnams rdzogs so// ka dpe tshig lhug pa gcig kyang yod do// tshig bcad 'di gtso bor mdzad do// maṅga laṃ/ ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ ṣaṭa dharma u pa de sha nā ma// bod skad du// chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba// dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// dal 'byor rgyu 'bras las rnams las// rnal 'byor don gyi snying po btsal// rnal 'byor lus kyi rtse yi tshogs// phra rags rlung dang ldan pa ni// dbang du byed thabs 'khrul 'khor gyis// dbyung rngub dgang dang gzhil ba ste// la la nā dang ra sa nā// a wa dhū tī 'khor lo bzhi// lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi me// phra rab las 'phel haṃ las ni// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dga' bzhi'i 'gros// rgyu mthun la sogs 'bras bu bzhi// 'khrul 'khor drug gis rgyas par bya// tsār+ya pa'i u pa de sha'o// snod bcud khams gsum ma lus pa// sgyu ma rmi lam la sogs dpes// 'gro 'dug spyod lam kun tu sbyang*// lha tshogs sgyu ma me long gzugs// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa// gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs// de nyid sgyu ma'i gzugs bzhin du// sgyu dpe bcu gnyis ltar mthong ba// rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i don mthong ba'o// na ga rdzu na'i u pa de shi'o// rmi lam rmi lam don shes shing*// rgyun du zab mo'i don bsgom pa// nā da thig le la sogs (107)pa// rigs lnga'i sa bon la dmigs nas// sangs rgyas zhing dang sangs rgyas blta// gnyis dus bde chen sgrub pa'i thabs// lwa ba pa'i u pa de sha'o// rnal 'byor a wa dhū tī pa// a wa dhū tīr sems gnas pa// snying gi thig ler sems brtan pas// 'od dang 'od zer 'ja' ris dag

/skya rengs nyi 'od zla 'od dang*// nyi ma zla ba shar 'dra gsal// lha dang sku yi snang ba sogs// sna tshogs zhing khams dag par 'gyur// rnal 'byor pa yi lam chen te// nā gā rdzu na'i u pa de sha'o// rnal 'byor 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe// dbang po rnams dang 'byung ba sdud// zla nyi rlung rnams snying gar 'dus// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin sna tshogs 'char// rnam shes phyi rol yul song na// rmi lam yul bzhin sna tshogs snang*// bdun bdun dus tshe 'chi snang dang*// de nas skye bar 'gyur ba nyid// de tshe lha yi rnal 'byor sgom// yang na de nyid ngang la gzhag /de rjes skye la phyogs pa'i tshe// mnga' bdag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis// snang srid lha yi rnal 'byor sgom// des ni bar do khegs par 'gyur// su kha sid+dhi'i u pa de sha'o// de las rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i tshe// grong 'jug lha dang sa bon gyis// 'gro 'ong ring dang thud pa dang*// lha la bslab cing 'phar ba'i dus// gang 'dod grong du 'jug par bya// gong du 'pho na stong rang lha// yaṃ sprod hi ka hūm̐ dang hūm̐// lha dang bla ma'i thugs kar 'phang*// des ni 'dod pa'i gnas su 'gro// su kha sid+dhi'i u pa de she'o// grub pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug til+li pa'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhas pa na ro paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ mar pa lho brag chos kyi blo gros kyis kha che'i gnas puṣ+pa ha rir bsgyur ba'o// 'di ni chos drug gi bka' dpe chung ba'am// rnal 'byor dbang phyug til+li pa'i chos drug gi gzhung chung yid bzhin nor bu zhes brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gdams ngag gi khungs su mdzad do/ ༈ / (108)mkhas grub chen po nā ro tā pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar po lo tsā la gdams pa'i chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur// rje bka' drin can gyi zhabs la 'dud// bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// dal 'byor lus kyi phung po'i yid// dbyar skye tshe na 'di skad lo/

༈ /sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gding*// lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad// phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nad na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// 'og na a shad rtsaṇ+ḍa yi// steng na haṃ yig rnam pa can// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo ni// srog rtsol bum can nyams len gyis// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams ngag zer// rlung gnad du chud dam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /phyi na snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smra ma btub// nyin mtshan snang ba sprul pa'i sku// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// zhen pa log gam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /rmi lam nyams kyi 'khrul pa'i dus// mgrin par oṃ yig 'od zer can// dran 'dun bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor las// skyes pa rmi na pho 'dre zer// bud med rmi na mo 'dre zer// byol song rmi na klu ru 'dzin// dga' ba rmi na sems dpangs bskyed// mi dga' rmi na snying mi dga'// 'dre sems kyi rtsa bar ma shes na// rnam rtog gi 'dre la zad pa med// bzang ngan rang grol ston pa'i don// ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer// rang bzhin shes sam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /gnyid dang rmi lam bar zhig na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// rmi lam 'od gsal 'thug po nyid// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung can// sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i lam// sgo brgyad bcad nas sgo gcig 'byed// (109)sems kyi mda' la rlung gi gzhu// hika gi rgyud kyis rab bskul nas// rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phen// ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer// rlung dus su khegs sam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /rang lus dus kyi tshad phebs la// gzhan lus mtshan ldan dam pa'i yul// bar na yig 'bru rlung gi rta// rten 'brel rlung gi 'khor lo yis// rang lus khang stong bzhin du bor// gzhan lus sprul sku'i ngo bo can// ming yang grong 'jug gi gdams ngag zer// rlung las su rung ngam lo tsā ba/

༈ /rmi lam dus kyi shes pa de// bar do'i sems dang bsre dgos pas// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i ngo bo can// dag dang ma dag gzugs sku gnyis// bar do'i dus su zin yang 'tshal// rmi lam bar do bsre 'pho gnad// mi yang bar do'i gdams ngag zer// bar do 'byongs sam lo tsā ba/ ༈ /lar phyi nang gi chos la thos pa dgos// go bas mtha' gnyis spong ba yin// yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod tsa na// gol sa med pa'i lam gcig yin// lam de la skyo ba ga la yod// ces gsungs so// 'di rje mar pa'i rnam thar las yongs su grags shing phyis kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis kyang gdams pa'i khungs su drangs shing rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig lta bur mdzad snang*// 'on kyang tshig mang nyung dang*// go rim mi gcig pa sogs 'dra min cung zad mang du gda' na'ang*// 'dir re zhig yongs grags nyid go bde bar snang bas de ltar bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /rje btsun chen po mi la ras pas mdzad pa'i snyan brgyud gsal ba skor gsum sogs bzhugs so// rje btsun mi las mdzad pa'i dngos po gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de// lus ngag yid gsum sprin tshogs kyis/ zung mang snyan brgyud// dus gsum du ni mngon phyag 'tshal// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob nas// gnyis med (110)gsal ba chos kyi dbyings// lam mchog de la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// ye shes sgron me la phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba rgyun gcod rab bsal ba// rab snang de la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma tai lo pas nā ro la gnang*// des mar pa la gnang*// de nyid kyi mi la la gnang*// zhabs drung du 'khor ba yun ring*// dod cing ni thos gyur na// thugs rjes ni dgongs nas gnang*// gdams ngag ni dang du blangs// rtsol sgrub ni drag tu byas// bsgom pas ni yon tan byung*// lus la ni gtum mo 'bar/

thos pa dka'// ras gos ni rkyang res dros// sems la ni 'od gsal shar// brgyud lugs ni mang gis kyang*// bod yul du brgyud pa la// 'di dang ni gzhan mi mnyam// khyad par ni bye brag ltos// nyams su len pa'i dus tsam na// shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam gyi rim pa dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus ni chos kyi gnas pa yin// de la gnad ni rnam gsum ste// lus dang yul dang dus kyang ngo*// dbugs la dbugs gnad rngub pa dgang ba gzhi yab mda' ltar 'phen pa'o/ bzhir ldan ma shes na// gang gi yon tan 'byung bar dka'// li ri bzhin du khong sgrim bya// rgya mdud bzhin du bsgom par bya// lcags kyu bzhin tu dgug par bya// re'u mig bzhin tu bsnol bar bya// mda' ltar gyen du 'phang bar bya// nam mkha'i ba ni yul gyi gnad rim gyis bzho// 'khor lo bzhi yi bsam gtan bya// a wa dhū ti'i stong ra 'di// stong pa'i nang nas stong pa mchog /gdams ngag khyad par mang gi kyang*// rtsa rlung gdams pa khyad par 'phags// nyams su blangs na yon tan 'byung*/ /des na bla ma dam pa spyi bor bkur// mig gi 'bras bu (111)bzhin du bca' bar bya// pho nya'i lam la dga' ba la// rig ma bsten pa'i dus tsam na// rang gis dbang bskur dad pa can// khro sems med cing snying rje che// shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma// gzugs mdzes lang tshos rnam par brgyan// bu srid tshul lam bran mo'i tshul// shin tu ngo tsha bsdams par bya// rig ma bsten pa'i dus dag tu// shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// lam gsum man ngag shes byas te// sgo gnyis khegs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rig ma bsten kyang 'gal ba med// khyad par rgyud nas spangs pa dang*// yon tan med pa spang ba'o// de la log rtog blo

bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas phyag 'tshal nas shes pa sbyong ba la sogs tshogs lam// snyoms 'jug sbyor lam/ skad cig la shes pa mthong lam/ ma skye// rdo rje 'chang gis sprul pa la// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yin// srog dang rtsol ba 'dzin dus su// mi rtog don la dmigs kyang rung*// thig le nya gang gcig la dmigs kyang rung*// phyag rgya mtshan ldan zhig la dmigs kyang rung*// gtum mo me khab tsam la dmigs kyang rung*// yar 'dren mar 'dren bzhu btul byad kyang dmigs pa yul gyi gnad rung*/ shes pa rnam rtog yul la ma 'phros na// de rnams gsal ba med kyang ni// rnam par rtog pa ngang gis 'gag /yon tan rnams ni rim gyi 'byung*// thabs lam khyad du 'phags pa'i man ngag 'di// slob ma snying dang 'dra ba ma gtogs pa// snod ngan gzhan la sbyin pa'i chos ma yin// des na gdams ngag snying gi dkyil du spos// las la brten nas yul de mthong bar nges// thabs la brten nas yon tan 'byung bar nges// rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung bar nges/ kha gsag g.yo sgyu can la sbyin mi bya// rgyu dang 'bras bu gdod nas gnyis med kyang*// rnam rtog dbang gi rgyu dang (112)'bras bur snang*// de ltar rtogs pa med pa'i gang zag rnams/ tshig tsam don du khyed na rang gzhan bslu// de de yin te de nyid min// de de mthong yang de ma mthong*// des na gdod nas sangs rgyas khas len pa// seng ge g.yang sar mchong ba'i rjes bzhin du/ phyi rabs kyi/ /bong bu mchong na srog dang bral bar 'gyur// skal ldan las can rnams kyi bdud rtsi 'di// skal med 'byung po rnams kyi dug tu 'gyur// mthu rtsal ldan pa stag gi lad mo 'di// dur khrod wa spyang rnams kyis spyad par dka'// bskos par gyur na sa la chu yang 'byung*// bsrub par gyur na shing la me yang 'byung*// mis ni rtsol sgrub dag ni byas gyur na// mi 'grub pa yi chos ni gang yang med// des na nyams su blangs pa rab tu gces// nyon mongs rnam rtog rim gyis 'gag gyur na// rang rig ye shes gsal ba'i ngo bo gsal// dge bcu spyad pas thar pa thob pa dka'// sdig bcu spangs pas mya ngan 'da' bar dka'// spang len gnyis kyis mi rtog 'char ba dka'// lus can dag ni kun la yang*// snying po don 'di gdod nas gnas// des na sems can sangs rgyas rgyu// rgyu las 'bras bu btab pa la// gdod nas thebs kyis da ltar min// da ltar 'debs byed rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog don du 'debs byed pa// me yis ma bsad ji bzhin du// smig rgyu dag la chur 'khrul bzhin// lta ba nyams su mi len par// thabs kyi khyad par nyams su longs// ma mthong yul de blta 'dod na// yul de yid la ma byed bar// lam gyi khyad par nyams su longs// thabs la bsten pa'i dus tsam na// rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu dngos// las can rnams kyis rtogs par rigs// stong pa ma yin

stong pa gang zhe na mi stong min// de nyid su la yod ce na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la mnga'/ rnal 'byor rig (113)pa'i blo la 'char// thun mong yod kyang khyad par 'phags// de yang thabs la bsten pas 'byung*// rab kyi yon tan bde stong rgyun par gnas// mnyam bzhag rjes thob med pa'o// 'bring gi rjes thob stong par rtogs// tha mas rjes thob sgyu mar mthong*// yang sems can thams cad/ rtogs ldan pa/ dag don la khyad med kyang*// rnam rtog la ni khyad du snang*// chu bo yi rgyun bzhin du// yun ni bsring bar gsungs// nam mkha'i sprin bzhin du// na bun ni glo bur pa// btsan thabs kyis mi dgag par// shugs 'byung gi stobs kyis dgag /dngos po gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba rje btsun mi la nyid kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// snyi ba rin po che las brgyud de 'ongs pa// lho pa

la yag pa byang chub dngos grub/ rin po che la gnang ba'o// des bdag la gnang ba'o/ ༈ /rje btsun mi la'i ma rig gsal byed ces bya ba// bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob nas// mthun pa'i gnas dang grub pa'i rdzas/ /'tsho ba'i dus gsum mkhyen pa/ yo byed bsags byas la// rkyen bzhi ldan pa shin tu gces// bya ba btang ba'i skyes bu yis// ji ltar chu dag dwangs pa las// nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar// skad cig tsam gyis lha ru bskyed// lam ni rnam pa gnyis gsungs te// smin par byed pa nyid dang ni// grol bar byed pa nyid yin no// smin par byed la lam dang ni// dbang ni rnam pa gsum du gsungs// smin te grol bar byed pa ni// bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs pa'o// bskyed pa de yang gnyis yin te// bskyed pa dang ni skyes pa'o// rdzogs pa la yang gnyis yin te// spros dang lhan cig skyes pa'o// spros bcas lus la rtsa dang rlung*// rlung la shes pa thig les brtan// de la mi rtog skye bar rigs// lus gnas lus la skyes pa'o// lus (114)la gnas kyang lus skyes min// dper na gru dang khang pa bzhin// nges lam 'bras bur bcas pa ni// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob nas// thabs lam las ni ma gtogs pa// yang dag yin no nga mi zer// rtogs pa'i khyad par ci byung yang*// ngag gi lam gyi yul las 'das// chags lam pa yi grol lam pa// tsum+ba ka yi sbyor ba yis// rtsol ba drag tu bsgrub par bya// srog rtsol gnas su 'jug par nges// 'byung ba gcig la gcig thim 'gyur// tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni shugs la 'bar// byang chub sems ni 'bar bar nges// nang gis tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags// dang po dro ba lta bu 'byung*// gnyis pa du ba lta bu 'byung*// 'du ba rnam bzhis gnod mi nus// de la lus ni bsgrub pa gces// lus ni brtan par gyur pa la// rtags ni rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// dga' ba rnam bzhi rim gyis 'byung*// phyi yi tsha grang bzod pa dang*// lus la srog chags nyung ba dang*// sha bkrag gting nas 'bar ba dang*// lus la dri ma mi chags dang*// shing bal ltar ni yang ba dang*// brkyang bskum gang yang bde ba dang*/

kha sna'i snabs lud nyung ba dang*// lus la dri zhim 'byung ba dang*// zas skom 'du shes chung ba dang*// rna bas sgra snyan thos pa dang*// gnyid kyi rtog pa chung ba dang*// dri ba'i lan la mkhas pa dang*// smra rgu snyan par smra ba dang*// tshig gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa dang*// rang gi skyon rnams 'chos pa dang*// smra ba don dang mthun pa dang*// pha rol skyon rnams 'chos pa dang*// rdzas la chog shes yod pa dang*// 'khor bar skyo ba skyes pa dang*// dben pa'i gnas la dga' ba dang*// gcig bur sdod snying 'dod pa dang*// yang yang bsgom snying 'dod pa dang*// lus nyid yod du mi tshor dang*// yul la nges pa med pa dang*// gnas gcig ther zug mi gnas dang*// (115)ḍā ki'i tshogs rnams 'du ba dang*// rmi lam lung bstan thob pa dang*// chos la byan po thob pa dang*// mngon shes rim gyis 'byung ba dang*// dri lugs la sogs 'byung ba dang*// phyi nang bsre bar nus pa dang*// bsdam bya gnod pa med pa dang*// dus la bab na gtong ba dang*// dus min lha ni gsod par byed// de la yid ches byar mi rung*// de la yid ches skyes gyur na// rnam rtog bdud kyi dbang du 'gro// de da yin te de nyid min// sdong bu yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min// nyam dang lta ba 'jom pa la// bdud bzhi'i dgra yis mi tshugs shing*// snang ba had por 'gro bar nges// phyi yi yul ni brtag mi thub// rang gi rang gsal nang na gsal// dper na lkugs pa'i rmi lam mam// gzhon nu ma yi bde ba bzhin// tha snyad tshig tu brjod tsam na// tsha grang 'dres pa'i yon tan gyis// 'du ba rnam bzhis gnod mi nus// bza' btung la sogs mi dgos pas// bshang gci la sogs 'byung mi 'gyur// mchog gi dngos grub shugs kyis 'byung*// lam la brten pa'i tshong pa yis// ma bgrod bsam kyang phyin mi 'gyur// tshong byas zas nor 'phel ba ltar// lam la brten pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// nyams myong rim gyis skye bar 'gyur// thabs la ma brten chos kyis ni// nyams su blangs kyang res 'jog tsam// rtogs snyam byed cing bogs mi thon// sangs rgyas rnams kyis sdem dgongs la// sems can rigs spyod bcug pa tsam// de nyid yin na de nyid 'gal// thos bsam mkhas pa'i mi rnams kyang*// tshig la rno la don la brtul// gol sgrib gdar sha bcad pa la// shugs 'byung snying las ma chod na// thos pa mang pos de mi chod// thos pa mang pos chod gyur na// mkhas pa dmyal bar ga la 'gyur// rang rig rang la shar ba la// thos pa mang pos der mi skyob// dper na sman dpyad bklag pa yis// nad pa'i nad sel ga la nus// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// shes rab ye shes dbang gi dus// (116)kha cig de nyid mthong zhes zer// nga ni de la 'thad pa med// zla ba yin te bco lnga min// shes pa yin te rtog med min// grib ma yin te lus po min// mtshon par bya ba tsam du bas// des na thabs lam brten par bya// tshogs lam brgal ba'i gang zag la// dngos dang yid la byed pa'o// yid la byed pa'i dus tsam na// gang 'dod yid kyis blang bar bya// de dang lhan cig rol ba na// bsam pa ji ltar 'dod par byed// de ni yid kyi spyod yul lo// rig ma dngos su bsten byed na// mtshan ldan rgyud sde kun nas bshad// rnal 'byor nga yi 'dod pa ni// yid du gang 'ong mtshan ldan yin// mang po 'tshogs na spyod lam mdzes// gsang spyod byed na khrel dang bral// de dang dben pa'i gnas nyid du// nyam nga med pa'i spyod pa bya// ma dang bu mo sring mo yang*// khyad par can gyi rten du 'gyur// yon tan 'byung gis skyon du min// yon tan med pa'i gdams ngag gis// de la bsam par mi bya'o// rgyud sde kun nas bshad pa la// ma sring bsten no bshad pa ni// sangs rgyas bka' ni sdem dgongs la/

kha cig gis ni med par mthong*// don dang mthun par mi bsgrub par// des na gang zag spyod par blang*// sbyor thabs mi shes rnal 'byor dang*// stan yang gcig la bsten gyur na// so so skye bo'i spyod pa rnams// phan yon mi 'byung skyon du 'gyur// des na sbyor thabs mkhas pas bsten// 'ga' dang 'ga' yi spyod yul las// kun gyi spyod yul 'di ma yin// des na gsang sngags spyod pa rnams// thabs lam ma song tho cor song*// yo tan ma song 'phyas lam song*// des na gsang ba spyad par bya// gsang sngags zab mo'i gdams ngag 'di// thabs lam tsam las ma gtogs pa// lta bas 'phags so da mi zer// ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu (117)zhan gyis ni 'gugs par byed// ji ltar khong du dug zhugs pa// slar yang dug gis 'byin par byed/ khye 'us khye'u 'byin pa dang*// dri mas dri ma 'khrud pa bzhin// nad rnams 'tsho bar byed 'dod na// sman gyi yan lag bsam mi khyab// des na thabs kyi lam 'di gces// gzhan du kha cig 'di skad zer// bskyed rim bsgom pa'i yon tan gyis// chos sku skye ba med pa las// gzugs sku gnyis su ldang nas ni// sems can 'gro don byed do zer// nga ni de la 'thad pa med// chos sku rnam dag med pa la// gzugs sku rnam dag 'byung rig sam// 'o na ji ltar yin zhe na// sa la gnas pa'i byang sems dang*// sems can bsam pa dag pa la// sngon gyi bsod nams stobs dag dang*// thugs rje chen po'i stobs dag gi /de ltar snang gis dngos su min// sgyu ma mkhan gyis ci sprul yang*// sgyu ma mkhan nyid der song med// rtogs par dka' ba'i don 'di ni// gnyis su med pa'i lta ba yin// ma hā mu tra'i dgongs pa la// rang gi 'od gsal gyi shes pa// cir yang mi rtog don de nyid// tshig dang yi ges mtshon nas ni// sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa na// rang la yod de rtogs pa med// ce re 'dug kyang long ba// dmigs pa med pa'i thabs lam// mtshan ma'i sku la slob pa// rnam dag bshur la 'debs pa// nyon mongs rim gyis 'gags pa// mi rtog shugs las 'byung ba// rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa// gzhan la bstan du 'phang ba// snod dang ldan la sbyin pa// nyams can rnams kyi lta ba// nyams su myong na tshim pa// tshig dang yi ge bsdebs pa// kun gyi spyod yul min pa// spyod pa yangs dogs med pa// bla ma'i drin lan sob pa// gcig pur dben par sdod pa// rang sems gtan la 'bebs/(118)pa// 'chi ba rjes su dran pa// ngan song gsum gyi 'jigs pa la// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa bstan// gzhan tu rnal 'byor lus dang gcig

/nyams su blangs pa'i chos dang gnyis// nyams myong skyes pa'i lus dang gsum// 'di gsum shin tu gsang na legs// dad pa can gyi ngor byas pa'o// drin tu gzo bar gyis shig /rje mi la ras pa'i nyams myong yi ger bkod pa// ma rig gsal byed ces bya ba rdzogs so// sa mā staṃ// snyi ba rin po che las brgyud/ ༈ rje btsun mi la'i rnam rtog dri ma dag byed ces bya ba// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir// dbang gi go ba rnam pa gnyis// gdod nas rang chas gnas pa dang*// rkyen gyi dbang gis bskur tshul lo// nyams su blangs pa'i thabs tshul dang*// nyams blangs rtogs pa shar tshul gnyis// de ni dbang gis go bar mthong*// dam tshig la yang gnyis su 'dod// bsrung dang ye bsrung chen po'o// bza' bsrung gnyis su 'dod pa ni// de ni bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /ye bsrung chen po 'bras bu dngos// lta ba yang ni gnyis su 'dod// lta ba gtan la 'beb lugs dang*// lta ba gtan la phebs lugs so// lta ba gtan la 'beb thabs ni// rtsa rlung 'khor lo gtsigs su che// srog rtsol gnad du ma tshud na// dbab thabs 'byung ba rig ma yin// des na thabs lam khyad du 'phags// gtan la phebs pa'i lta ba ni// nga 'dra rmongs pa ma yin gyi// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis kyang*// lkugs dang gzhon nu ji bzhin du /mtshon pa tsam las ma gtogs pa// ngo bo bstan par nus ma yin// sgom pa la yang rnam gnyis te// bsgom du yod dang med pa gnyis// mtshan ma'i sku yi rnal 'byor pas// de ni bsgom du yod pa yin// ngo bo nyid kyang de la bya// (119)skyon yon gnyis kyang de 'byung rigs// bcos thabs grangs kyis mi long gis// stong pa'i go cha gcigs su che// nges pa'i shes pa mi skye bar// nyams rtogs
